一个能在浏览器里打开的提示卡页面，而且你能指着每一段说出它在做什么。: A hint-card page you can open in a browser and explain, section by section.
文本编辑器与浏览器；可选任意 AI 编程工具。无需账号或付费 API。: A text editor and browser; any AI coding tool is optional. No account or paid API required.

AI can draft files, explain errors, and suggest implementations, but its claim of completion cannot replace actually running the page in a browser. This course limits the scope to one reading hint card.
网页文件是浏览器读取的材料。你用编辑器修改它，再用浏览器打开，看到文字、布局与按: Webpage files are material a browser reads. Edit them in an editor, then open them in a browser to see text, layout, and button behavior. AI having generated these files does not mean the running page is still talking to a model; a simple expandable hint needs only prepared content and a few lines of code.
准备一个独立文件夹、文本编辑器与浏览器即可开始，可选自己已有的 AI 工具。先用: Begin with a separate folder, text editor, and browser, optionally using an AI tool you already have. First describe “click to show a hint; click again to hide it” in plain language. Leave login, online generation, and paid services until there is a real need. Your deliverable is a small interaction you can explain and check.

否，要看页面是否实现了模型请求。: No; it depends on whether the page implements model requests.
开发方式与产品运行方式是两件事。: How a product is developed and how it runs are different things.

样式不能决定是否联网调用。: Styling does not determine whether a network request occurs.

文件名末尾的 .html 告诉我们它是网页文档。文本编辑器里的标签页是正在编辑的: The .html filename extension identifies a web document. 文件没有误存成 .html.txt。: The file was not accidentally saved as .html.txt.
编辑与预览指向同一份内容。: The editor and preview refer to the same content.

是否打开了正确文件并刷新。: Whether you opened the right file and refreshed.

新账号不能修复文件路径。: A new account cannot fix a file path.
把所有文件删除重建。: Delete every file and start over.

HTML：给内容起正确的角色: HTML: give content the right role
用标题、段落、链接与按钮表达页面内容的用途。: Use headings, paragraphs, links, and buttons to express the purpose of page content.
HTML 元素由标签和内容组成，例如 h1 包住主标题，p 包住段落。标签不只是: HTML elements consist of tags and content: h1 wraps a main heading and p wraps a paragraph. Tags do more than set default appearance; they tell the browser and assistive technology the content's role. Bold text alone is not a structurally meaningful heading.
在阅读活动里，主题用主标题，材料用段落，前往来源用链接，展开提示用按钮。链接有目: In a reading activity, use a main heading for the topic, paragraphs for the material, a link to visit a source, and a button to expand a hint. Links have destination addresses; buttons perform actions in the current interface. Native elements provide useful keyboard and browser behaviors without custom implementation.
属性补充元素信息：id 是页面内用于定位的名称，href 是链接地址，lang: Attributes add information: id names an element for locating it within the page, href gives a link destination, and lang declares the document language. IDs must be unique within a document. Make the unstyled structure readable before adding styles so learning material retains a clear order if styles fail to load.
去掉颜色还能读懂吗？: Can you still understand it without color?

导航与动作控件用途匹配。: Navigation and action controls match their purposes.
重要内容脱离样式仍能读懂。: Important content remains understandable without styling.
“打开参考资料”前往另一网址，优先用？: “Open reference material” goes to another URL. Which element is preferable?
需要额外补行为和语义，原生链接更合适。: It requires extra behavior and semantics; a native link is more suitable.
它表达导航，也保留浏览器原生能力。: It expresses navigation and preserves native browser capabilities.
图片并不能提供可操作的链接入口。: An image alone does not provide an actionable link.
CSS：让同一条规则作用到合适内容: CSS: apply a rule to the right content
读懂选择器、属性和值，并定位样式影响的范围。: Read selectors, properties, and values, and identify the scope of a style change.
CSS 用规则描述元素如何呈现。一条规则先写选择器，说明选中哪些元素，再在花括号: CSS rules describe how elements appear. A rule begins with a selector identifying which elements it matches, followed by properties and values in braces. For example, p selects paragraphs, and line-height adjusts line spacing. You need not memorize every property: first identify what a rule selects and what it changes.
若把 button 的字号调大，页面上的多个按钮可能一起改变；若只想改提示按钮，: Increasing the font size for button may change several buttons at once. To target only the hint button, give it a dedicated class. Multiple stylesheet rules can match one element, so adding a rule does not always override earlier styles as expected; inspect which rules actually apply.
对教师阅读页，优先考虑行宽、字号、间距和清楚的焦点，再选择颜色。不要为解决一个按: For a teacher's reading page, prioritize line length, font size, spacing, and visible focus before choosing colors. Do not change every element to fix one button. Change one property at a time and observe to connect cause and effect. An attractive screenshot still needs checks with long content and narrow screens.
一条规则影响几个按钮？: How many buttons does one rule affect?
先预测 button 与 .hint-button 两个选择器各会选中谁；给页面: Predict which elements button and .hint-button select. Add two buttons, give only one the class, and change its border to observe the scope.
为提示按钮添加类名，只调整它的内边距；再调正文行高，记录每次改动对应的可见变化。: Add a class to the hint button and change only its padding. Then adjust the body text's line spacing and record the visible result of each change.
能指出选择器与属性。: I can identify a selector and a property.
知道全局规则可能影响多个元素。: I know global rules may affect multiple elements.
焦点轮廓没有被删除。: The focus outline has not been removed.
只改提示按钮，避免影响其他按钮，应该？: How should you change only the hint button without affecting other buttons?
给它明确类名并针对该类写规则。: Give it an explicit class and target that class.
选择范围与改动范围一致。: The selection scope matches the intended change.
把所有元素的字号都改掉。: Change the font size of every element.
范围过大，容易造成无关变化。: The scope is too broad and may cause unrelated changes.
无需移除功能来缩小样式作用范围。: You do not need to remove functionality to narrow a style rule's scope.
读懂变量、布尔值与点击处理之间的关系。: Understand the relationship between variables, Boolean values, and click handlers.
JavaScript 能保存当前信息并响应动作。变量是程序里给一个值取的名字，布: JavaScript stores current information and responds to actions. A variable names a value in a program. Boolean values are either true or false and often represent expanded versus collapsed. Understanding this state transfers to other small interactions more easily than memorizing an entire button script.
事件是浏览器报告发生的事情，例如用户点击按钮。事件处理函数则是事件发生后要做的一: An event is something the browser reports, such as a button click. An event handler is the sequence of steps to run afterward. On each click, the hint card first toggles its expanded state, then updates visible content, button text, and aria-expanded so different ways of using the page receive consistent information.
如果只改文字却忘了实际隐藏提示，页面会出现相互矛盾的状态。要把“存的值”和“看到: Changing only text while forgetting to hide the hint creates contradictory states. Check both the stored value and the visible content. Ordinary variables initialize again after a refresh. Persisting across refreshes requires a separate storage design; naming a variable saved does not automatically save it.
两次点击为什么应该回到起点？: Why should two clicks return to the starting point?
预测 closed→open→closed 的每一步按钮文字；点击两次，对照 h: Predict the button text at each step of closed→open→closed. Click twice, compare hidden and aria-expanded, and explain why state, appearance, and semantics must stay synchronized.
在已有代码旁写注释：选元素、监听点击、改变状态、更新页面；用两次点击与刷新检查自: Annotate the existing code: select elements, listen for clicks, change state, update the page. Check your explanation using two clicks and a refresh.
知道 true/false 表示两种状态。: I know true/false represents two states.
能找到事件处理代码。: I can locate the event handler.
不会把临时变量当永久记录。: I do not mistake a temporary variable for a permanent record.
按钮文字说“已收起”但内容仍在，说明？: The button says “Hidden,” but the content remains visible. What does this mean?
程序必然正确，只是用户误解。: The program must be correct; the user is mistaken.
文字与可见状态已经不一致。: The text and visible state are inconsistent.
隐藏问题不能修复状态同步。: Concealing the problem does not repair state synchronization.
需要检查同一次动作是否更新了全部相关显示。: Check whether the same action updates every related display.
交互正确性涉及状态及其多个呈现位置。: Correct interaction involves state and all the places where it is represented.
让 AI 接到可检查的任务: Give AI a task you can verify
用情境、范围和验收条件组织一次小改动。: Organize a small change using context, scope, and acceptance criteria.
“做一个更好的学习网站”包含太多未决定的问题。把任务压到一个动作：谁在什么情境下: “Make a better learning website” leaves too many decisions unresolved. Reduce the task to one action: who clicks which button, in what context, what changes, and which conditions must hold.
在提示卡例子中，支持需要可请求、可收起。让 AI 一次只改这一段交互，并解释修改: In the hint-card example, support should be available on request and collapsible. Ask AI to change only this interaction and explain the files modified and why. You decide whether learners need that support; AI's implementation proposal does not establish educational value.
每次改动先留版本，再检查差异和实际行为。如果 AI 添加了你没要求的登录、追踪或: Keep a version before each change, then inspect differences and actual behavior. If AI adds unrequested login, tracking, or third-party services, ask it to explain why they are necessary. Smaller changes are easier to evaluate.
验收条件就是别人可以照做的检查句子，例如“按第二次按钮时，提示收起”。先在纸上走: Acceptance criteria are checks another person can follow, such as “the second button press hides the hint.” Walk through two levels of hints on paper and predict the sentence after each click before asking AI to code. Do not leave undecided rules for the tool to guess.
可以直接改写的任务描述: A task description you can adapt

根据自己的学习场景改写这份描述。可交给 AI 实现，也可手动修改；无论哪种方式，: Adapt this description to your learning scenario. Ask AI to implement it or edit manually; either way, predict behavior first, then check each condition.
需求包含具体使用者、动作与结果。: The requirement names a specific user, action, and result.
提示没有替学习者直接完成全部判断。: The hint does not do all the learner's reasoning for them.
我检查了代码差异，而不只看 AI 的总结。: I inspected the code differences, not just AI's summary.
AI 说“已经优化学习效果”，你下一步应该做什么？: AI says it has “optimized learning outcomes.” What should you do next?
把这句话直接写进产品介绍。: Put the claim directly in the product description.
实现报告不能支持教学效果主张。先核对行为，再设计对学习目标的检查。: An implementation report cannot support a learning-effectiveness claim. Check behavior first, then design a check aligned with the learning objective.
检查交互是否满足需求，再单独验证学习者表现。: Check that the interaction meets requirements, then separately evaluate learner performance.
功能正确和教学有效需要不同的证据。: Functional correctness and educational effectiveness require different evidence.
只看新增了多少行代码。: Look only at the number of new code lines.
改动量不能说明功能是否正确，也不能代替学习表现证据。: Change size does not establish correctness or replace evidence of learning.
让 AI 解释修改，再核对真实文件: Ask AI to explain changes, then inspect the real files
检查 AI 的修改范围与实现证据，而不只接受完成总结。: Check the scope and implementation evidence rather than merely accepting a completion summary.
AI 回答“已完成”时，可能是在描述计划、已写入文件的代码，或自己推测的运行结果: When AI says “done,” it may describe a plan, code actually written to files, or a presumed runtime result. Distinguish these cases. Ask for the files actually changed, key changes, and checks actually executed, then confirm them in the files and browser.
例如只要求提示可以收起，却发现新增账号系统和第三方脚本，修改范围就扩大了。先读差: If you requested only a collapsible hint but find a new account system and third-party scripts, the scope has expanded. Read the diff and ask whether those changes are necessary for this task. Without a clear reason, return this iteration to one interaction. Dependencies are external code borrowed by a project and add understanding and maintenance costs.
不懂某行代码时，可以请 AI 用“输入是什么、会改哪个值、会影响哪里”解释，再用: For an unfamiliar line, ask AI to explain its input, which value it changes, and where its effects appear, then verify with a concrete action. Matching predictions to observations gradually builds judgment. You need not pretend to understand all code immediately, but an unexplained large change is not automatic progress.
总结与差异对不上: When the summary and diff disagree
预测“只改按钮文案”应出现几类文件变化；查看实际差异，若出现网络配置或依赖文件，: Predict the types of file changes a “button text only” edit should produce. Inspect the actual diff; if it includes network configuration or dependency files, ask how they relate to the task.
为一次小改动写检查记录：AI 声称、文件实际、浏览器结果各一项；解释一个你亲自验: Record one small change in three parts: AI's claim, the actual files, and the browser result. Explain a causal relationship you verified yourself.
区分计划、写入与实际测试。: I distinguish plans, written changes, and actual tests.
差异范围与需求相符。: The diff's scope matches the request.
未执行的测试明确写未测试。: Checks not executed are explicitly marked untested.
AI 说通过测试，却没有步骤和输出时应该？: AI claims tests passed but provides no steps or output. What should you do?
直接把结论当最终验收。: Accept the claim as final sign-off.
尚缺可核对的执行证据。: Verifiable execution evidence is still missing.
请求具体检查依据并自己走关键路径。: Request concrete evidence and walk through the critical path yourself.
把声明连接到文件和行为才能验收。: Acceptance requires connecting claims to files and behavior.
未确认基础行为时扩展范围会更难定位。: Expanding before confirming basic behavior makes problems harder to locate.
把“坏了”变成可复现的问题: Turn “it broke” into a reproducible problem
用步骤、期望与实际结果描述问题，完成一次回归检查。: Describe steps, expected and actual results, and perform a regression check.
报告问题时保留最短复现步骤。例如“打开页面 → 用 Tab 聚焦按钮 → 按 E: Keep the shortest reproduction steps, for example: “Open the page → focus the button with Tab → press Enter; expected: a hint appears; actual: nothing changes.” Record the browser, window width, and first relevant console error.
如果按钮标签变了但提示没出现，检查隐藏属性与样式；如果什么都没发生，检查脚本是否: If the button label changes but the hint does not appear, inspect hidden attributes and styles. If nothing happens, check whether the script executes and finds the elements. Change only one suspected cause at a time to avoid introducing mixed problems.
修好后重测之前正常的行为：首次打开、重复点击、收起、窄屏、键盘。能跑起来是开始，: After fixing it, retest previously working behavior: first load, repeated clicks, collapse, narrow screens, and keyboard use. Getting it running is a start; explaining how you verified it supports further iteration.
控制台是浏览器展示脚本消息和错误的区域，可从开发者工具打开。错误常包含位置与原因: The console displays script messages and errors in browser developer tools. Errors often include a location and cause. Start with the first relevant message and confirm element names correspond to the actual page; red text alone is no reason to rewrite everything.
环境：桌面浏览器，窗口宽 390px。 步骤：打开页面，连续点“打开提示”两次。: Environment: desktop browser, 390px-wide window. Steps: open the page and click “Show hint” twice. Expected: the second click hides it and restores “Show hint.” Actual: the text resets but the hint remains visible. Check: inspect hidden after the second click and see whether CSS overrides hiding.
在练习副本里把脚本的 #hint 暂时改成 #hint-typo，观察并记录控制: In a practice copy, temporarily change the script's #hint to #hint-typo. Observe and record the console error, then repair it. Finally run your five checks and record results.
问题记录包含期望和实际结果。: The issue report includes expected and actual results.
修复后重测首次使用与重复操作。: After the fix, I retested first use and repeated actions.
页面在窄屏下没有横向挤出。: The page does not overflow horizontally on a narrow screen.
为什么修复一个按钮后还要测试收起和重复点击？: Why test collapsing and repeated clicks after fixing a button?
因为同一次修改可能影响共享状态。: The same change may affect shared state.
对。回归检查覆盖已有行为，避免只验证刚修好的单一步骤。: Correct. Regression checks cover existing behavior rather than only the newly repaired step.
只要第一次成功，后续状态一定正确。: If the first attempt succeeds, later states must be correct.
交互包含不同状态，首次成功不代表每次切换都正确。: Interactions have multiple states; initial success does not prove every transition works.
只有上线以后才需要检查重复点击。: Repeated clicks only need checking after deployment.
本地就能发现状态问题，越早检查越容易限定原因。: State problems can be found locally; earlier checks make their causes easier to isolate.
交付一个别人能重现的提示卡: Deliver a hint card someone else can reproduce
整理运行说明、验收结果与限制，完成第一个网页闭环。: Organize startup instructions, acceptance results, and limitations to complete your first webpage.
完成网页不只是把文件发出去。接手者需要知道打开哪个文件、怎样看到主要行为、有哪些: Finishing a webpage involves more than sending files. The next person needs to know which file to open, how to see the main behavior, and the known limitations. A README is more reliable than asking a colleague to find the final code snippet in chat, and helps your future self continue editing.
准备一份验收表：首次打开提示隐藏；点击出现；再点收起；键盘可操作；窄屏文字可读。: Prepare acceptance checks: hints start hidden, a click reveals them, another hides them, keyboard operation works, and narrow-screen text is readable. Record actual results instead of pre-checking every item. If it runs by opening a file directly, state that there are no accounts, uploads, or model requests; do not imply a deployed service.
保存一个已检查的版本，并记录仍想做但本轮未做的功能。下一步可以进入互动网页课处理: Save a checked version and record ideas outside this iteration. Next, study forms and storage in the interactive-web course or organize entry points in the landing-page course. A small artifact you can explain, run, and recheck establishes the working habits needed for more complex projects.
交给明天的自己: Hand it to your future self
预测只拿文件夹还能否在一分钟内启动；关掉当前页面，按 README 从头打开并走: Predict whether you could start within a minute using only the folder. Close the current page, follow the README from scratch, run acceptance checks, and explain any missing instruction.
交付 index.html、README 和五项实际验收记录；重新从说明启动一次: Deliver index.html, a README, and five actual acceptance results. Start once more from the instructions and correct any mismatch with the page.
说明能从零启动到主要交互。: The instructions lead from a fresh start to the main interaction.
五项检查写了真实结果。: The five checks record real results.
功能边界与后续计划分开。: Current limitations and future plans are separate.
最可靠的小作品交付包含什么？: What belongs in a reliable small-project handoff?
缺文件入口与行为证据。: The file entry point and behavioral evidence are missing.
截图只能展示某一时刻的外观，无法证明点击和收起都能运行。: A screenshot shows appearance at one moment, not whether opening and collapsing work.
运行文件、启动说明、检查结果和限制。: Runnable files, startup instructions, check results, and limitations.
它让别人能够独立验证与继续维护。: These let others verify and maintain it independently.
把学习科学变成设计判断: Turn learning sciences into design decisions
从学习科学是什么开始，理解回想、间隔、示范、反馈与迁移，把一个教学活动改成有证据: Start with what learning sciences studies. Understand retrieval, spacing, modeling, feedback, and transfer, then turn a teaching activity into a product flow with evidence you can examine.
一页活动设计、具体练习与反馈，以及延后检查和下一轮改进记录。: A one-page activity design, concrete practice and feedback, a delayed check, and notes for the next improvement.
带着一个班、教案已经写熟，却说不清学生到底学会没有的老师: Teachers who know their lesson plans well but cannot clearly tell whether their class has learned
我讲得很清楚，学生当场也点头说懂了，一到考试还是不会。: I explain it clearly, and students nod and say they understand, but they still cannot do it on an exam.
一页写下来的活动设计：练什么、怎么给反馈、隔几天用哪道题再查一次。: A one-page activity plan: what to practice, how to give feedback, and which question to revisit a few days later.
无需编程。带来一个你熟悉的教学主题，纸笔即可。: No coding needed. Bring a familiar teaching topic and a pen and paper.
学习科学如何帮助你做出好产品: How learning sciences helps you build better products
区分好用、喜欢和学会，说明学习科学能帮助做出的设计判断。: Distinguish usability, enjoyment, and learning, and explain the design decisions learning sciences can inform.
学习科学研究人如何获得、理解、保持和使用知识，也研究课堂、工具与社会互动怎样影响: Learning sciences studies how people acquire, understand, retain, and use knowledge, and how classrooms, tools, and social interaction influence that process. It combines perspectives including psychology and education research. For teachers building educational products, its value is turning “this feature looks good” into “what does it ask learners to do, why might that help, and how can we check?”
例如两个背词页面都很漂亮：一个不断播放词义，另一个先遮住解释，请学习者回想，再核: Consider two attractive vocabulary pages: one repeatedly plays definitions; the other hides the explanation and asks learners to recall before checking. They provide different learning activities, so click counts alone cannot compare them. First decide whether the goal is recognizing a word, writing it, or using it in a new sentence, then choose an appropriate check.
研究提供可参考的机制与适用条件，不会替某个新产品自动背书。一个好产品还需要能打开: Research offers mechanisms and conditions to consider; it does not automatically endorse a new product. A good product must also open reliably, make sense, and support task completion. This course connects goals, practice, support, feedback, and delayed checks into a small activity while identifying observations that cannot yet support effectiveness claims.
两张词卡，哪张留下证据？: Two vocabulary cards: which leaves evidence?
预测：看过词义与遮住词义后自己解释，哪一种更容易暴露不会的地方？尝试各做两张纸卡: Predict which better reveals gaps: reading a definition or hiding it and explaining it yourself. Try two paper cards of each kind and record omissions. Explain the difference through the response required, not card color. This small experience does not establish long-term effects.
选一个你想做的教育工具，分别写“用户操作”“目标表现”“检查时间”；用两种纸面流: Choose an educational tool you want to build. Write down the user action, target performance, and checking time. Try two paper flows and explain what evidence each leaves.
能用日常语言解释领域关注的问题。: I can explain the field's concerns in everyday language.
没有把喜欢或点击当作掌握。: I do not equate enjoyment or clicks with mastery.
能说出一个需要后续验证的产品假设。: I can name one product hypothesis needing further verification.
一个工具有很多人连续打卡，接下来怎样判断它是否帮助学会？: Many people maintain a daily streak in a tool. How should you next check whether it helps them learn?
打卡反映参与，尚未显示目标知识是否能独立使用。: A streak indicates participation, not independent use of the target knowledge.
安排与目标对应的独立任务，并在稍后再次检查。: Set an independent task aligned with the goal and check again later.
表现和时间都与学习目标有关，仍需谨慎解释因果。: Performance and timing both matter to learning goals; causal claims still require caution.
把按钮换成更醒目的颜色。: Make the button color more noticeable.
颜色可能改善操作，却不能代替对学习表现的检查。: Color may improve operation but cannot replace checking learning performance.
先弄清学习者已经知道什么: Find out what the learner already knows
用一道起点任务识别知识缺口，避免把新手卡住误判为不认真。: Use a starting task to identify knowledge gaps rather than mistaking a beginner's difficulty for inattention.
新知识需要和已有知识连接。老师说“找出论据”时，熟悉写作的人知道要找支持主张的材: New knowledge connects with existing knowledge. When a teacher says “find the evidence,” an experienced writer knows to look for material supporting a claim; a beginner may not distinguish a claim from an example. The same page presents different difficulty to different people. Grade level or self-reported proficiency alone should not determine support.
起点检查不是入学考试。给一小段材料，请学习者圈出作者要你相信的结论，再说哪句话支: A starting check is not an entrance exam. Give a short passage, ask the learner to identify the conclusion the author wants accepted, and name a supporting sentence. Observe the reasoning method. Ask why an incorrect answer was chosen to distinguish unfamiliar terms, misunderstanding the passage, or assuming every number is evidence.
据此准备两种入口：已经能说明理由的人直接尝试新例子；还分不清的人先看一句带解释的: Prepare two entrances accordingly: learners who can explain their reasoning try a new example; those still distinguishing the parts see a short explained model first. Allow switching so one answer does not become a permanent ability label. Recording needed support is more useful than a “weak student mode” and easier to revise as evidence changes.
预测：不认识“论据”和相信“有数字就可信”，会需要同一种提示吗？分别扮演两位学生: Predict whether not knowing “evidence” and believing “numbers make a claim trustworthy” need the same hint. Role-play both learners and compare a definition with a question about sources.
写一道两分钟起点题，列出两种可能错误及不同帮助；试用后补一句证据不足时如何继续询: Write a two-minute starting question, two possible errors, and different support for each. After trying it, add how you would ask further questions when evidence is insufficient.
题目检查了本课必需的前提。: The question checks a prerequisite needed for this lesson.
学习者可以离开或重新进入支持路径。: Learners can leave or re-enter a support path.
学生把一句含数字的广告当作证据，首先应该？: A student treats an advertisement containing a number as evidence. What should you do first?
重复题目前需知道判断错误的原因。: Before repetition, find out why the learner made that judgment.
固定标为低能力。: Permanently label the learner as low ability.
一次表现不足以给人稳定标签。: One performance does not justify a stable label.
请他说明为什么相信这个数字。: Ask why they believe the number.
理由能帮助区分来源判断与术语理解问题。: The reasoning helps distinguish source evaluation from understanding terminology.
先确定要留下什么证据: First decide what evidence to collect
把“看懂了”改成一个可以观察的学习表现。: Turn “understood it” into an observable learning performance.
“学会辨认事实与观点”比“读完这一页”更接近学习目标，但还不够具体。加上任务和条: “Learn to distinguish fact from opinion” is closer to a learning goal than “finish this page,” but still needs detail. Add the task and conditions: given three unfamiliar statements, identify which require verification and explain why. Then design practice accordingly.
提取练习让学习者尝试从记忆中产生答案。重新阅读与主动回忆做的是不同的事。先尝试、: Retrieval practice asks learners to produce an answer from memory. Rereading and active recall are different activities. Trying before checking reveals uncertainty; questions should fit prior knowledge and allow correction after checking.
一次答对不证明已经长期学会。你可以安排稍后再做一道不同表面的题，观察是否还能说明: One correct answer does not establish long-term learning. Later, use a question with a different surface context and see whether the learner can still explain the reasoning. This is a design for checking learning, not a guarantee of any tool's effectiveness.
把阅读完成率换成学习证据: Replace reading completion with learning evidence
原活动：读完“事实与观点”的解释后点“我懂了”。 改造：暂时收起解释，请判断“这: Original activity: read the explanation of fact and opinion, then click “I understand.” Revision: hide the explanation and decide how to verify “There are 12 trees on this street” and “This street is the most beautiful.” Write reasons, then reopen the explanation to compare.
先预测“重读解释”和“遮住解释回答”会留下什么不同证据。为自己的主题写一句可观察: Predict the different evidence left by rereading an explanation versus answering with it hidden. Write an observable goal and a question that cannot be answered by copying the original wording. Try it, then explain how omissions should shape the next practice.
目标说明了学习者要做的动作。: The goal specifies what the learner will do.
学习者在看到答案前有一次独立尝试。: There is an independent attempt before the answer appears.
核对后有修正机会，并计划稍后再检查。: Checking is followed by a chance to revise, with a later check planned.
哪个证据最能回应“学习者能区分事实与观点”？: Which evidence best addresses whether a learner can distinguish fact from opinion?
他打开解释页三次。: They opened the explanation three times.
这是使用记录。还不知道他是否能进行判断。: That is a usage record; it does not show whether they can make the judgment.
他给陌生陈述分类，并说明可以怎样查证。: They classify unfamiliar statements and explain how each could be verified.
它直接呈现目标表现。仍需用更多题目和后续观察判断稳定性。: This directly shows the target performance. More questions and later observations are still needed to assess stability.
他说页面很容易理解。: They say the page is easy to understand.
体验反馈有用，但不能替代对学习目标的检查。: Experience feedback is useful but cannot replace checking the learning goal.
把复习分开：为什么隔一段时间再想: Space reviews: why recall again after a delay?
安排有核对的延后回想，理解间隔是设计变量而非神奇日历。: Plan delayed recall with checking, treating spacing as a design variable rather than a magic calendar.
今天连续解释三次很顺，不代表下周还能解释。间隔练习把接触同一知识的机会分散到不同: Explaining something smoothly three times today does not mean you can explain it next week. Spaced practice distributes encounters with knowledge across time so learners recall again after some forgetting. Because the concern is future retrieval, checks must extend beyond the moment of learning.
为“事实与观点”安排今天学习、明天回想、几天后用新句子判断，是一个可试的起点，并: For fact and opinion, studying today, recalling tomorrow, and judging new sentences a few days later is a starting experiment, not an optimal schedule for everyone. Difficulty, prior knowledge, and desired retention duration all affect timing. Offer cues and checking when recall fails rather than letting errors persist.
产品可以记录练习日期与错在哪里，帮助老师调整下次任务。不要把倒计时到点当成已经学: A product can record practice dates and specific mistakes to help teachers adjust the next task. A countdown reaching zero is not learning, and missing a day need not erase all progress. Comparing schedules with similar total practice makes spacing easier to discuss; one personal experience cannot establish a universal effect.
同样六次，时间如何分配？: Six attempts: how should they be distributed?
先预测一天做六次和三天各做两次哪个更容易在最后一天显得顺手；画出两条时间线。再说: Predict which feels easier on the final day: six attempts in one day or two on each of three days. Draw both timelines, then explain why immediate fluency and retention a week later differ. Do not invent a memory curve.
把三次练习放进一周日历，每次注明题目、核对办法及答不出时的支持；到期记录真实表现: Schedule three practices over a week, each with a question, checking method, and support if recall fails. Record actual performance when due; do not prefill scores.
复习要求产生答案而非只打开材料。: Review requires producing an answer, not merely opening material.
日程被说明为可调整的尝试。: The schedule is described as an adjustable experiment.
复习提醒按时弹出，能说明什么？: A review reminder appears on time. What does that show?
通知送达还没有学习者的回答。: A delivered notification contains no learner response.
说明安排触发了，仍需观察回想与核对。: The schedule was triggered; recall and checking still need observation.
区分系统事件和学习活动才能读懂记录。: Distinguishing system events from learning activities makes records interpretable.
难度应根据表现与目标调整，不能由时钟决定。: Adjust difficulty using performance and goals, not the clock alone.
先给一个例子，再逐步放手: Show an example, then gradually step back
安排完整示例、部分支持与独立尝试，避免一直替学习者做决定。: Arrange a worked example, partial support, and an independent attempt without continually deciding for the learner.
新手可能同时卡在任务规则、操作步骤和学科内容上。一个讲清理由的完整示例，可以展示: Beginners may struggle simultaneously with task rules, procedures, and subject content. A complete example that explains its reasoning can show the path from problem to judgment. An example should make key decisions visible, not merely present a correct answer.
随后减少支持：先留下一个步骤让学习者补充，再换一道题独立尝试。支持不应按固定点击: Then reduce support: leave a step for the learner to complete, followed by a new independent problem. Do not remove support mechanically after a fixed number of clicks; consider whether the learner can continue. Offer a smaller hint if they are stuck, and avoid redundant explanation if they are proficient.
这里采用“先看完整范例，再逐步撤去支持”的安排。它并不意味着所有问题都应先展示完: This sequence uses a worked example followed by fading support. It does not mean every problem should begin with a complete answer: task type, prior knowledge, and the value of exploration affect the order. Scaffolding is temporary assistance, not permanent decision-making on the learner's behalf.
交互图换用分数比较演示同一机制：零级不提供提示，之后依次显示比较方向、部分步骤与: The interactive figure demonstrates the same mechanism through fraction comparison: level zero has no hint, followed by a comparison cue, partial steps, and a worked example. Predict which step you must supply when support decreases, then switch levels. These levels represent support amount, not an ability test.
同一个目标，三个支持程度: One goal, three levels of support
① 示范：“种了 12 棵树”可通过计数核对，因此是可查证陈述。 ② 补全：“这: ① Model: “There are 12 trees” can be checked by counting, so it is verifiable. ② Complete: What conditions might matter for “This street is quiet”? Add a reason. ③ Independent: Given a new sentence, choose a verification method before the page provides a category.
先预测减少完整步骤后，学习者必须自己做哪个判断。把题扩展成完整范例、补一步、独立: Predict which judgment the learner must make when complete steps are removed. Expand the question into a worked example, one missing step, and an independent attempt. Rehearse it and explain what each stage removes and when a hint should return.
示例展示了判断理由，不只有结论。: The example shows reasoning, not only a conclusion.
每次减少的支持明确且幅度可控。: Each reduction in support is explicit and manageable.
最后一步有独立判断，也允许重新求助。: The final stage requires independent judgment while allowing renewed help.
哪个调整更能帮助你判断学习者是否已经独立完成？: Which change better helps you determine whether the learner can now work independently?
每一道题旁边都保留同样的完整答案。: Keep the same complete answer beside every problem.
这样容易把复制示例误当成独立判断。: Copying the example may then be mistaken for independent judgment.
换一道新题，先不给完整步骤；需要时可请求提示。: Give a new problem without complete steps initially, with hints available on request.
能够观察独立尝试，并保留支持。记得记录是否使用了提示。: This reveals an independent attempt while retaining support. Record whether hints were used.
第三次点击后永久禁用提示。: Permanently disable hints after the third click.
点击次数不代表准备程度；机械撤去支持可能让任务无法继续。: Click count does not indicate readiness; mechanical withdrawal may prevent progress.
识别任务需要的思考与界面额外造成的记忆负担。: Identify thinking required by the task versus extra memory demands caused by the interface.
工作记忆是眼前暂时保留、处理信息的能力。新手一边记操作步骤、一边找说明、一边理解: Working memory temporarily holds and processes information. A beginner remembering instructions, searching for guidance, and understanding a new concept may lose track of one. Cognitive load theory draws attention to these simultaneous demands, but it does not imply that easier learning is always better.
在分数比较活动里，让学生判断大小是要保留的思考；让他记住上一屏分子、翻页找分母，: In fraction comparison, judging magnitude is thinking to preserve; remembering a numerator on one screen while paging elsewhere for the denominator may be extra burden. Place quantities to compare together to reduce searching. Proficient learners may not need every step expanded, so allow support to collapse.
你可以记录哪里需要翻页、哪里忘了条件，作为改版线索；这些记录不是脑内负荷的直接测: Record where users page back or forget a condition as redesign clues; these are not direct measurements of mental load. After removing decoration or combining instructions, check whether the target task improves. Showing the answer sooner may reduce effort while also removing the judgment learners should practice.
预测：跨两屏比较与同屏比较，哪种更需要记住中间信息？用纸遮挡模拟两版，记录找回数: Predict which requires remembering more intermediate information: comparing across two screens or on one. Simulate both with paper covers, count trips back to the numbers, and explain which steps disappeared and which mathematical judgments remain.
画出一个跨屏任务，把必要材料放近；写出保留的核心挑战和减少的一项找路动作。: Sketch a task spanning screens and bring essential material together. State the core challenge retained and one navigation action reduced.
没有把所有困难都当坏事。: I do not treat every difficulty as harmful.
调整指向具体信息处理要求。: The change targets a specific information-processing demand.

自我解释是学习者说明某一步为什么成立，或它怎样连接到已有知识。它不同于把教师的话: Self-explanation means stating why a step is valid or how it connects to existing knowledge. “不对，再想想”没有告诉学习者从哪里改。“你真聪明”也没有指向当前任务。可执行的: “Wrong, think again” does not tell a learner where to change. “You are so clever” does not address the task either. Actionable feedback locates a gap and offers a next step related to the goal.
不要一次列出所有问题。针对这次任务最关键的一个决策，提供足够但不过量的信息，再让: Do not list every problem at once. Target the most important decision in this task, provide sufficient but not excessive information, and let the learner revise. Only after revision can you observe whether feedback was used.
在教育产品里，反馈也是一种交互：文字在哪里出现、是否保留原回答、能否比较修改前后: In an educational product, feedback is also an interaction: where it appears, whether the original answer remains, and whether before and after can be compared affect actionability. 反馈指出具体差距，语气针对任务而非个人。: Feedback identifies a specific gap and addresses the task rather than the person.
下一步动作可执行，没有直接包办全部思考。: The next action is feasible and does not do all the thinking for the learner.
有修改机会和新的检查题。: There is a revision opportunity and a new check question.

停留时间不能说明反馈被怎样理解和使用。: Time on screen does not show how feedback was understood or used.
原回答、修改后回答，以及修改理由。: The original answer, revised answer, and reason for the change.
它们帮助你看见行动变化；仍应检查理由与目标是否一致。: These reveal changed action; still check whether the reason aligns with the goal.
页面自动加一颗星。: The page automatically adds a star.
奖励是界面反应，并不是学习者采取行动的证据。: A reward is an interface response, not evidence of learner action.
把“我会了”与实际表现对照: Compare “I can do it” with actual performance
用预测与表现差距决定下一步练习，而非给人贴自信程度标签。: Use the gap between predictions and performance to choose practice rather than labeling a person's confidence.
元认知是对自己学习过程的认识与调节。校准则是把“我觉得能做到”与“实际做到了什么: Metacognition involves awareness and regulation of one's learning. Calibration compares “what I think I can do” with “what I actually did.” Familiarity with a page or a recently seen answer can inflate expectations of independent performance, so external performance provides a reference.
例如先预测三道证据判断题能解释清楚几道，再关掉材料作答，用事先写好的要点核对。若: First predict how many of three evidence-judgment questions you can explain, then close the material, answer, and check against predefined key points. If you expected three but explained only one, investigate whether the gap concerns concepts or evidence-finding methods. The numbers guide the next activity rather than judging a person's confidence.
对照以后要有行动：重新看一个示范、求助、换一道题，或者稍后再试。只画信心曲线而不: Comparison should lead to action: revisit a model, ask for help, try a different problem, or return later. A confidence curve without concrete strategies offers beginners little help. Self-ratings must not automatically become system ability levels; a learning assistant should distinguish personal judgments from evidence in actual responses.
先写预计能解释几题，再独立完成并按理由核对；用两列展示预期与结果。解释一个差距及: Write how many you expect to explain, then answer independently and check the reasons. Show expectations and results in two columns. Explain one gap and a corresponding practice strategy; example numbers are not real learner data.
用三道自己的题做一次预测—作答—核对，挑一个差距写出具体下次行动。: Complete a predict–answer–check cycle using three of your own questions and choose one gap for a concrete next action.
预测在看答案前完成。: The prediction happens before seeing answers.
差距连接到一项可执行调整。: A gap leads to one actionable adjustment.
预测全会、核对发现漏掉关键理由时，更合适的是？: You predicted complete understanding but omitted a key reason. What is more appropriate?
提高自评分数以保持动力。: Raise your self-rating to preserve motivation.
掩盖差距不能帮助选择练习。: Hiding the gap does not help choose practice.
针对漏掉的理由看示范后再试新题。: Study a model addressing the missing reason, then try a new question.
用表现调整策略，才完成监控与调节的循环。: Adjusting strategy from performance completes the monitoring and regulation cycle.
让系统永久降低能力标签。: Let the system permanently lower your ability label.
一次差距不足以定义稳定能力。: One discrepancy cannot define stable ability.
相似题混在一起，练习选择方法: Mix similar problems to practice choosing a method
说明混合练习怎样要求辨别，并保留必要的基础教学。: Explain how interleaving requires discrimination while retaining necessary foundational teaching.
连续做同一类题时，题目顺序已经提示了方法。交错练习把容易混淆的类型放在一起，让学: When every problem is of the same type, the sequence itself cues the method. Interleaving places confusable types together so learners must first choose the relevant concept or procedure. Alternating area and perimeter prevents simply reusing the previous formula.
交错不是随机把所有知识混成一团。学习者需要先理解基本方法，材料之间也应有值得区分: Interleaving is not randomly mixing all knowledge. Learners first need basic methods, and the materials need meaningful distinguishing features. Start with two types, asking which condition justifies the method, then gradually reduce prompts. If learners know neither method, supply prerequisite knowledge.
混合后当场更慢，不一定说明设计失败；同样，更难也不自动证明有效。研究效果随学科、: Slower immediate performance after mixing does not necessarily mean failure; increased difficulty also does not prove effectiveness. Effects vary with subject, material similarity, and arrangement. Observe method choice, calculation, and delayed performance rather than deciding from immediate accuracy alone whether to remove or expand mixing.
围篱笆还是铺草皮？: A fence around the edge or turf inside?
预测同样写着“长六米、宽四米”的两道题是否都应相乘；再按围边与覆盖内部分类，解释: Predict whether two problems both stating “six meters long, four meters wide” require multiplication. Sort them by enclosing the boundary or covering the interior, and explain how the task determines the method.
写四张题卡，含两类易混任务；先分组再混合，记录选方法的理由和一条仍需解释的差异。: Write four problem cards containing two confusable task types. Practice grouped and then mixed, recording the reason for method choice and one difference still needing explanation.
混合的类型有明确可比较特征。: The mixed types have explicit comparable features.
检查了方法选择而不只有答案。: The check examines method choice, not only answers.
交错练习最直接增加的要求是什么？: What demand does interleaved practice most directly add?
每题都用上一题的方法。: Use the previous problem's method every time.
交错正是要减少靠顺序猜方法。: Interleaving aims to reduce guessing the method from sequence.
在多种方法中判断当前该用哪一种。: Decide which of several methods fits the current problem.
可辨别的条件与方法选择是核心。: Discriminating conditions and choosing methods are central.
无关材料的混杂不等于有目的的交错。: Unrelated material mixed together is not purposeful interleaving.
换了故事，还能认出同一个关系吗: Can you recognize the same relationship in a new story?
设计表面不同但关键结构相同的新任务，谨慎解释迁移。: Design new tasks with different surfaces but the same key structure, and interpret transfer carefully.
迁移是把学过的知识用于不同情境。学生在街道例子里能区分事实与观点，到了短视频广告: Transfer means using learned knowledge in a different context. A student who distinguishes fact and opinion in a street example may not spontaneously apply the same method to a short-video advertisement. Repeating the original example shows some memory but does not fully establish use elsewhere.
设计迁移题时，先明确要保持的关系，例如“陈述能否按公开方法查证”，再改变材料表面: When designing a transfer question, specify the relationship to preserve, such as whether a statement can be verified by a public method, then change the surface: topic, wording, or medium. Ask students to compare cases and identify changed details and the unchanged criterion, rather than merely swapping names.
初次迁移可以提醒方法，随后需要在没有明显提示的任务中检查是否主动使用。难度应逐步: Early transfer attempts can include a method reminder, followed by a task without an obvious cue to check spontaneous use. Increase difficulty gradually; do not jump into a domain requiring extensive unfamiliar knowledge and attribute all failure to poor transfer. Success in one new context supports performance there, not general thinking ability.
从街道评价到商品广告: From judging streets to evaluating advertisements
先预测“这款水杯最好”和“容量五百毫升”各需什么查证方式，再与街道例子配对；解释: Predict how to verify “This is the best cup” and “Its capacity is 500 milliliters,” then pair them with street examples. Explain that the criterion remains while the topic changes.
把原活动改写到一个新情境，列出不变关系、变化细节和新增前提；安排一次不先提示策略: Rewrite the original activity in a new context. List the invariant relationship, changed details, and new prerequisites, and plan a check without an advance strategy reminder.
新题保留了目标关系。: The new task preserves the target relationship.
没有偷偷增加大量陌生知识。: It does not quietly introduce extensive unfamiliar knowledge.
报告区分有提示与无提示表现。: The report distinguishes prompted and unprompted performance.
把原题换一个人名后答对，最合理的结论是？: A learner succeeds after only a name changes in the original problem. What is the most reasonable conclusion?
已证明所有情境都能运用。: Use in every context has been established.
很小的表面变化不足以支持广泛迁移。: A tiny surface change cannot support broad transfer.
保持与主动使用仍未检查。: Retention and spontaneous use remain unchecked.
在这个相近变式中成功，还需新的情境证据。: They succeeded on this close variation; new-context evidence is still needed.
结论范围与观察范围一致。: The conclusion stays within the scope of the observation.
交付一份有证据边界的活动设计: Deliver an activity design with clear evidence limits
把机制、实施与检查写在一页中，并用观察修订产品。: Put the mechanism, implementation, and checking on one page, and revise the product through observation.
设计评审不是给页面贴上越多学习理论越好。你需要说明学习者现在遇到什么困难、准备让: Design review is not about attaching as many learning theories as possible to a page. Explain the learner's current difficulty, what you will ask them to do, why that action might help, and what performance will be checked. Concept names can serve as an index but cannot replace causal explanation.
把活动写成一页：目标是独立判断陌生陈述；先做起点题；必要时看示例；再回想判断标准: Write a one-page activity: independently judge unfamiliar statements; begin with a starting check; view an example if needed; recall the criteria; revise after feedback; and revisit with new material the next day. Record interface problems, content errors, and learning difficulties separately because they require different changes.
请同事走一遍可用性流程，之后再在适当情境收集学习表现。小规模观察可以发现问题，但: Ask a colleague to walk through usability, then collect learning performance in an appropriate setting. Small observations can uncover problems, but without comparisons, sufficient samples, and consideration of alternative explanations, do not claim the product caused improvement. Deliver observed changes, unanswered questions, and the smallest next revision together.
一个按钮两种证据: One button, two kinds of evidence
预测“能打开提示”与“关掉提示仍能判断”分别检查什么；亲自走两条路径，把结果放进: Predict what “can open the hint” and “can still judge with the hint closed” each assess. Walk through both paths and record results under functionality and learning. Explain why both are needed and neither substitutes for the other.
完成一页活动设计及一份三栏记录：观察、解释、下一步；选一个最影响目标的问题修改并: Complete a one-page activity design and a three-column record: observation, interpretation, next step. Revise the problem most affecting the goal and check again.
每个功能对应明确学习动作。: Every feature corresponds to a clear learning action.
观察与原因推测分开写。: Observations and proposed causes are recorded separately.
结论没有超出证据支持的范围。: Conclusions do not exceed what the evidence supports.
试用后最有用的报告是哪一种？: Which report is most useful after a trial?
加入提取练习，所以必然有效。: It includes retrieval practice, so it must work.
研究机制不等于该产品已经验证。: A research mechanism does not establish that this product has been validated.
列出观察到的表现、未回答问题和下一轮检查。: List observed performances, unanswered questions, and the next checks.
报告让后续设计有依据，也保留结论边界。: The report supports future design while preserving limits on conclusions.
只写界面很受欢迎。: Only say the interface is popular.
体验是一个维度，还需检查目标表现。: Experience is one dimension; target performance still needs checking.

一个使用合成材料的本地练习原型，以及一份检查与扩展计划。: A local practice prototype using synthetic material, with a checking and extension plan.
觉得自己孩子值得一份只为他准备的练习、而不是一套通用题库的家长或自学者: Parents or self-directed learners who want practice tailored to a learner rather than a generic question bank
他错的一直是那几道，可软件还在让他反复做已经会的题。: The same few questions keep causing mistakes, but the software keeps repeating things already mastered.
一个在本地跑起来的练习原型：先作答、再核对、写下一次从哪一题继续。: A working local practice prototype: answer first, check next, and record where to resume.
完成网页入门；能编辑 HTML 和 JavaScript。先不使用真实学生数据。: Complete the web basics course; be able to edit HTML and JavaScript. Do not use real student data initially.
先定义助手支持的学习动作: First define the learning action the assistant supports
把“智能助手”缩成一个明确学习循环。: Reduce “intelligent assistant” to one explicit learning cycle.
从“回答任何问题”开始，很难检查助手有没有帮助。先选一个范围：帮助自己回想三条已: Starting with “answer any question” makes it hard to assess usefulness. Choose a scope: help yourself recall three previously learned concepts, check the explanation, and write a next step. Review the material beforehand.
最小循环是“看题 → 独立回答 → 对照参考 → 写出差距 → 安排下一次”。参: The minimal cycle is “see question → answer independently → compare with a reference → identify a gap → plan next time.” The reference must not overshadow the question initially, or users may mistake understanding an explanation for producing an answer independently.
为一次练习设定具体情境，例如晚饭后用五分钟回想两张卡片。这个原型帮助你观察流程，: Set a concrete context, such as five minutes after dinner recalling two cards. This prototype helps you observe the flow; it does not automatically select optimal review intervals or diagnose learning ability.
纸卡也能检验这个顺序：先预测自己是否能解释，翻开题目尝试，再对照参考说出差距。之: Paper cards can test the same order: predict whether you can explain, reveal the question, try, then compare with the reference and name a gap. The webpage simply organizes these actions. Resembling a chat interface does not automatically confer diagnostic capability.

Reference: No; evidence must involve performance relevant to the learning goal. ② Question: When should you view the reference explanation? Reference: Try independently first, then compare and revise. ③ Question: What is still needed after feedback? Reference: The learner must actually revise or try again. These are course practice materials, not automatically generated individual assessments.
选自己熟悉的主题写三张卡片，每张包含题目、审核过的参考解释和来源。先拿纸卡手动走: Write three cards on a familiar topic, each with a question, reviewed reference explanation, and source. Walk through the cycle manually with paper cards first to find ambiguous questions.
问题范围清楚且有可核对参考。: The question has a clear scope and a checkable reference.
看答案之前有独立尝试。: There is an independent attempt before viewing the answer.
我说明了助手目前做不到什么。: I state what the assistant currently cannot do.
为了观察学习者能否主动回想，初始界面应该怎样？: To observe active recall, what should the initial interface do?
同时展示题目与完整答案。: Show the question and complete answer together.
这样很难区分主动回想与照着答案复述。: That makes active recall difficult to distinguish from repeating the displayed answer.
先显示题目，用户尝试后再主动打开参考。: Show the question first; after attempting, users deliberately open the reference.
这能保留回想的机会，同时让核对成为明确动作。: This preserves recall while making checking an explicit action.
自动填好回答，再让用户点完成。: Automatically fill in the answer and ask users to click Done.
系统代答取消了主动产生答案的机会，完成记录无法说明回想。: Answering for users removes answer production; completion records cannot show recall.
规则助手、生成助手与人的分工: Separate rules, generation, and human responsibility
识别固定规则可以完成的动作，明确哪些输出需要人工审核。: Identify actions fixed rules can perform and outputs that need human review.
助手是帮助你完成任务的一套流程，不必一开始就有聊天框。按顺序出示卡片、隐藏参考、: An assistant is a workflow that helps complete a task; it need not begin with a chat box. Showing cards in sequence, hiding references, and saving reflections can all follow deterministic rules. Given the same input and state, a rule-based program returns a predefined result that is easy to understand and check.
生成式模型则根据输入产生文本，可能出现意外表达或错误。让它草拟候选题可以节省起稿: A generative model produces text from input and may generate unexpected wording or errors. Drafting candidate questions may save writing time, but does not mean it knows an individual student's mastery. Decide which parts people must review and how to proceed when output is unreliable.
本课程只实现本地、预先审核的卡片助手。交互图中的阶段切换与示例回复都是脚本演示，: This course implements only a local assistant with pre-reviewed cards. Stage changes and example replies in the interactive figure are scripted demonstrations, with no real model calls or automatic diagnosis. Labeling capabilities accurately lets you first test the workflow's usefulness, then decide whether external services are worthwhile.
同一句话为何总是出现？: Why does the same sentence always appear?

交付时发现没有模型请求，名称与说明应该？: At handoff, there are no model requests. What should the name and description do?
清楚描述本地卡片助手与脚本流程。: Clearly describe a local card assistant and scripted flow.
准确的范围说明是可用产品的一部分。: Accurate scope is part of a usable product.
无需调用模型也可以形成有用的学习流程。: A useful learning flow does not require a model call.
让别人一眼知道从哪开始：做工具的介绍页: Make the starting point obvious: build a landing page for your tool

东西已经做出来了，却没人看懂它是给谁用的老师或独立开发者: Teachers or independent developers who built something but whose audience cannot tell who it is for
我把链接发出去，别人点进来看两眼就走了，一句话也不问。: I share the link, people look briefly and leave without asking anything.
一个单页原型：首屏一句话说清给谁用，只有一个主按钮，手机上也不错位。: A one-page prototype: the first screen identifies the audience, offers one main button, and stays usable on phones.
完成网页入门，或能在现有页面中修改 HTML 与 CSS。: Complete web basics, or be able to edit HTML and CSS in an existing page.
先选一种来访者与一个任务: Choose one visitor and one task first
用具体场景缩小首页的服务对象，形成可检查的主路径。: Use a concrete scenario to define the main audience and a verifiable primary path.
首页是访客理解产品并选择下一步的入口。它不需要在第一屏解释所有技术，而应帮助一个: A homepage helps visitors understand a product and choose their next step. It need not explain every technology on the first screen; it should help a real person with an immediate task. Imagine a teacher preparing lessons with only a few minutes to find a discussion activity for tomorrow, not investigate the website's entire architecture.
写下她从哪里来到页面、带着什么疑问、希望带走什么。如果同页同时面向学生、家长、教: Write where she arrived from, what she wants to know, and what she hopes to leave with. If students, parents, teachers, and developers all receive equally prominent entrances, no one may know where to begin. Prioritize one main visitor and support other needs with clear secondary links.
本课程会为虚构阅读活动库做首页：访客读介绍、看示例、理解使用方式并找到材料。这样: This course builds a homepage for a fictional reading-activity library: visitors read the introduction, see an example, understand how to use it, and find materials. That makes entry effectiveness checkable. A persona describes a task, context, and constraints rather than invented age and hobby labels; revise it as real observations arrive.
两位访客会点同一处吗？: Would two visitors click the same entrance?
预测备课老师与想看源码的开发者各自需要哪个入口；写两条访问路线，选本轮主要路线并: Predict the entrances needed by a teacher preparing lessons and a developer seeking source code. Write both journeys, choose this iteration's primary one, and explain the tradeoff.
写一个来访场景，限定一个主要任务；列出完成它必须回答的三个问题，暂不画视觉细节。: Write one visitor scenario with a single primary task. List three questions the page must answer to complete it, without drawing visual details yet.
对象由任务与情境定义。: The audience is defined by task and context.
主路径只有一个优先目标。: The primary path has one priority goal.
没有把假设当真实调研数据。: Assumptions are not presented as actual research data.
首页面向所有人导致入口拥挤时，先做什么？: A homepage targeting everyone has crowded entrances. What should come first?
视觉放大无法解决优先级冲突。: Visual enlargement does not resolve conflicting priorities.
明确主要来访任务并组织主次入口。: Clarify the main visitor task and organize primary and secondary entrances.
先决定服务路径，布局才有依据。: Deciding the journey gives the layout a basis.
术语可能进一步提高理解门槛。: Terminology may further raise the comprehension barrier.
首屏先回答一个问题: Answer one question on the first screen
让访客理解这是给谁、解决什么、下一步做什么。: Help visitors understand who this is for, what it solves, and what to do next.
教育产品很容易用“大模型赋能学习”介绍自己，却让访客猜具体用途。先写一个对象、一: Educational products often describe themselves as “LLM-powered learning” while leaving visitors to guess the purpose. State an audience, situation, and deliverable action: provide adaptable evidence-discussion activities for teachers who need classroom discussion materials.
标题负责说清价值，下面一句话补充范围，主按钮指向真实可达的下一步。研究设想应有明: The heading states the value, the next sentence clarifies scope, and the main button leads to a real next step. Give research ideas explicit statuses so experimental capabilities do not appear available already.
用一个真实截图、示例题或可打开的演示支持介绍。没有数据就不编造提升比例；有案例也: Support the introduction with a real screenshot, sample question, or accessible demonstration. Do not invent improvement percentages without data. Explain what a case demonstrates instead of automatically generalizing to all learners.
动手前先预测陌生访客点按钮后期待什么，再把目的地真实打开核对。首页文案和链接是一: Before editing, predict what an unfamiliar visitor expects after clicking, then open the actual destination and compare. Copy and links form one promise: clear text pointing to the wrong resource still blocks progress.
把架构介绍换成具体入口: Replace architecture talk with a concrete entrance
标题：把一段阅读材料变成证据讨论。 说明：选一个示例，改写问题与提示，带进你的下: Heading: Turn a reading passage into an evidence discussion. Description: Choose an example, adapt its questions and hints, and bring it to your next class. Primary action: Open an example. Note: Static activity templates are currently available; there is no automatic grading or validated classroom-effectiveness claim.
写出自己的标题、说明与按钮文字。把它交给不了解项目的人，只问“你觉得这里能帮你做: Write your heading, description, and button text. Show them to someone unfamiliar with the project and ask only, “What do you think this helps you do? What will appear after clicking?” Record the response before explaining.
对象与任务具体。: The audience and task are specific.
主按钮指向现有内容。: The primary button leads to existing content.
没有把设想、演示和已验证结果混写。: Plans, demonstrations, and validated results are not conflated.
哪种按钮文字更便于预测下一步？: Which button label makes the next step easier to predict?
它很难说明点击后的具体结果。: It does not describe a concrete result of clicking.
说明了对象和动作，前提是按钮确实指向该示例。: It specifies the object and action, provided the button really leads to that example.
抽象承诺没有说明具体对象或目的地，访客仍需猜。: An abstract promise names neither a concrete object nor destination, leaving visitors to guess.
用可打开的示例支持承诺: Support the promise with an accessible example
区分功能演示、研究设想与效果证据。: Distinguish functionality demonstrations, research ideas, and effectiveness evidence.
“帮助老师快速准备讨论”是一个需要具体支持的承诺。示例题、活动截图或能打开的模板: “Help teachers prepare discussions quickly” needs concrete support. Sample questions, activity screenshots, or accessible templates show visitors what they will receive. These establish the existence of materials or functions, not improved grades in every classroom.
为首页选一段真正可访问的阅读材料，展示一个问题和一条提示，再写清楚使用条件。尚在: Choose genuinely accessible reading material for the homepage, show one question and one hint, and explain conditions of use. Label exploratory automatic feedback as research rather than placing it beside downloadable templates in a way that implies everything is available.
没有测量数据时不要编“提升百分之多少”；有访谈反馈也应注明它反映体验。真实案例可: Without measurements, do not invent percentage improvements. Interview feedback should be identified as experience feedback. Describe real cases with their process and boundaries, avoiding universal causal implications. Aligning promises, demonstrations, and destinations reduces disappointment and makes later user tests easier to interpret.
截图能证明多少？: How much can a screenshot prove?
预测一张漂亮活动截图能否证明学生记得更久；点击示例核对功能存在，再列出要证明记忆: Predict whether an attractive activity screenshot proves longer retention. Open the example to confirm functionality exists, then list observations still needed to establish retention.
选择一个现有示例，写“展示了什么”“尚未证明什么”；把草稿能力与可用能力分别标明: Choose an existing example and state what it demonstrates and what it has not established. Label draft and available capabilities separately.
没有使用无依据的效果比例。: No unsupported effectiveness percentages are used.
活动截图最直接支持哪种说法？: What claim does an activity screenshot most directly support?
截图没有提供学习效果数据。: A screenshot provides no learning-effectiveness data.
需要具体人群与表现证据。: That requires evidence from a specific population and performance.
当前提供这种题目与提示的示例。: An example with these questions and hints is currently available.
可打开的题目与提示能支持“提供示例”，但不直接支持学习效果。: Accessible questions and hints support “example available,” not a direct learning-effectiveness claim.
用内容顺序回答访客疑问: Use content order to answer visitors' questions
把首页拆成每段承担一个问题的内容结构。: Break the homepage into sections, each answering one question.
内容结构是页面先说什么、后说什么，以及各部分怎样连接。对于活动库，可以依次回答“: Content structure determines what the page says first and next and how sections connect. An activity library might answer “Is this for me?”, “What do the materials look like?”, “How do I use them?”, and “What are the limits?” Writing short answers first reveals omissions more easily than filling a blank page with cards.
每个区域最好有一个能独立理解的标题。示例区放实际材料，步骤区说明操作，限制区交代: Each section should have a heading understandable on its own. Examples show actual material, steps explain actions, and limitations define current scope. If two sections repeat “innovative empowerment,” neither helps visitors progress. Replace duplicated slogans with real prerequisites or usage instructions.
导航应与页面结构对应。页内链接跳到真实存在的标题区域，固定顶部导航也不能把目标遮: Navigation should match the structure. In-page links must reach actual heading sections, and fixed navigation must not cover the target. A single-column first version is enough to check order; add columns later based on content relationships without breaking the reading sequence on narrow screens or assistive technology.
把页面剪成四张纸: Cut the page into four pieces of paper
预测打乱顺序后访客会先问哪个问题；把介绍、示例、步骤、限制四张纸重新排序，解释每: Predict which question visitors ask first if the sequence is shuffled. Reorder introduction, example, steps, and limitations, explaining which question each answers.
写四个区域标题与每区两句内容；检查每个标题是否独特，删除一处重复口号并补真实信息: Write four section headings and two sentences per section. Check that headings are distinct, remove one repeated slogan, and add real information.
每区回应一个具体疑问。: Each section answers a concrete question.
步骤区与介绍区内容完全重复，应该？: The steps section repeats the introduction. What should you do?
保留，因为重复越多越可信。: Keep it because more repetition builds credibility.
重复口号没有提供操作信息。: Repeating slogans adds no operational information.
让步骤区说明真实的开始方法。: Make the steps explain how to actually begin.
不同区域承担不同问题才能推进理解。: Different sections must answer different questions to advance understanding.
把重复句子全部变成图片。: Turn every repeated sentence into an image.
改变媒介不解决信息缺失。: Changing the medium does not fix missing information.
制作语义清楚、窄屏可读、键盘可达的页面骨架。: Build a semantic page skeleton that reads well on narrow screens and works with a keyboard.
用 main 包住主要内容，用标题组织层级，链接负责前往目的地，按钮负责当前页面: Wrap primary content in main, organize heading levels, use links for destinations, and buttons for actions on the current page. Enlarging text alone does not make a heading, and clickable divs should not replace native controls.
先用单列完成“介绍 → 示例 → 如何使用 → 限制与来源”。宽屏再增加列数。正: Start with one column: introduction → example → how to use → limits and sources. Add columns on wider screens. Limit text width and space cards so the same content remains readable on a phone.

Accessibility means people using different interaction methods can read and use the content; a keyboard journey is our initial check.
少量结构就能明确下一步: A little structure makes the next step clear
