做出单页原型，把全部链接点一遍。缩到 390px 宽，只用键盘走完整个主路径；给: Build the single-page prototype and open every link. At 390px width, complete the primary path using only a keyboard. Add image alternatives appropriate to their purpose.
Tab 能到达全部交互元素并看到焦点。: Tab reaches every interactive element with visible focus.
窄屏不遮挡正文或主行动。: Narrow screens do not obscure text or the main action.
“查看示例”会跳转到另一页，应该优先使用什么？: “View example” navigates to another page. What should you use first?
带正确 href 的链接。: A link with the correct href.
链接表达导航目的，浏览器和辅助技术能使用其原生行为。: A link expresses navigation and offers native browser and assistive-technology behavior.
只有 onclick 的普通段落。: An ordinary paragraph with only onclick.
它缺少原生链接语义和键盘行为，徒增实现负担。: It lacks native link semantics and keyboard behavior, adding unnecessary implementation work.
只有外观像按钮、没有链接地址的 span。: A button-looking span without a destination.
视觉外观不提供导航语义；应让目的地成为可操作的链接。: Appearance provides no navigation semantics; make the destination an actionable link.
先定几条视觉规则，再做装饰: Set a few visual rules before decorating
用字号、间距与颜色表达层级，并保持规则一致。: Use type size, spacing, and color to express a consistent hierarchy.
视觉规则是重复使用的选择，例如正文大小、标题层级、卡片间距和主按钮样式。它让访客: Visual rules are repeated choices such as body size, heading levels, card spacing, and primary-button styling. They keep visitors from guessing what matters in every section. Design quality is not the number of colors but whether similar purposes are represented consistently.
给阅读活动首页先定正文、二级标题和主标题三档字号，再定几档间距。主行动用清楚文字: For the reading-activity homepage, set three type levels—body, secondary heading, main heading—and a small spacing scale. Give the main action clear wording and sufficient distinction; keep secondary entrances visible without competing equally. Error and success states need text, not red and green alone.
这些规则需要在真实长标题、中文段落与窄屏里检查。不要先用两三个短英文词调到漂亮，: Test these rules with real long headings, Chinese paragraphs, and narrow screens. Do not perfect a design with a few short English words and insert Chinese afterward. Hierarchy serves reading and action, preserving focus outlines and contrast. A brand's character should rest on understandable content.
所有按钮都最亮，会发生什么？: What happens when every button is the brightest?
预测三个同样醒目的按钮是否还有主次；用纸或浏览器调整一主两次的样式，让别人指出先: Predict whether three equally prominent buttons still have a hierarchy. Restyle them as one primary and two secondary actions, on paper or in a browser, and ask someone what to do first and why.
给首页写一份四项小规范：正文、标题、间距、主行动；应用到两个区域，检查一致性和长: Write four small homepage rules for body text, headings, spacing, and primary action. Apply them to two sections and check consistency and long text.
相同用途使用相同样式。: The same purpose uses the same style.
状态信息不只靠颜色。: Status information is not communicated by color alone.
长中文内容也经过检查。: Long Chinese content has also been checked.
主行动文字具体且明显，次要链接清楚可见。: A specific, prominent primary action with clearly visible secondary links.
层级和可预测文字一起帮助选择。: Hierarchy and predictable wording work together to guide choice.
运动会竞争注意，也可能增加访问障碍。: Movement competes for attention and can create accessibility barriers.
主次并不意味着牺牲必要信息的可读性。: Hierarchy does not require sacrificing necessary information's readability.
手机适配从内容挤压处检查: Check mobile layouts where content starts to squeeze
理解流式布局与断点，用真实窄屏路径验收。: Understand fluid layouts and breakpoints, and verify a real narrow-screen journey.
响应式布局让同一份内容根据可用宽度调整排列。它不只是把桌面截图整体缩小，否则字和: Responsive layout rearranges the same content for the available width. It is not simply shrinking a desktop screenshot, which makes text and buttons difficult to use. Text containers can contract with the window, cards can change from columns to one column, and images should remain within their containers.
断点是样式改变排列的宽度条件，应由内容开始拥挤的位置决定，而不必背几个设备型号。: A breakpoint is a width condition that changes layout. Choose it where content becomes crowded rather than memorizing device models. Complete the single-column path on a narrow screen, then widen the window to see when extra columns help. Long headings, Chinese buttons, and browser zoom expose fixed-width constraints.
在约三百九十像素宽度检查首屏、示例与行动入口，再用键盘走一遍。若出现横向滚动，先: At about 390px, check the first screen, example, and action entrance, then walk through using a keyboard. If horizontal scrolling appears, look for oversized images, unwrappable text, or fixed-width blocks rather than hiding overflow to conceal content. Success means the task remains achievable, not merely aligned cards.
卡片为什么突然挤出屏幕？: Why does the card suddenly stick out of the screen?
预测固定六百像素卡片放进窄屏的结果；把宽度改为受容器约束的值，缩放窗口，解释哪个: Predict the result of a fixed 600px card on a narrow screen. Constrain it to its container, resize the window, and explain which constraint changed the layout.
把首页从窄屏拖到宽屏，记录一处开始拥挤的位置；修复后重测长标题与按钮点击区域。: Resize the homepage from narrow to wide and record where crowding starts. After fixing it, retest long headings and button hit areas.
窄屏正文和按钮完整可见。: Body text and buttons remain fully visible on narrow screens.
没有用隐藏溢出掩盖重要内容。: Overflow hiding does not conceal important content.
断点能解释为内容需求。: Breakpoints can be explained by content needs.
手机上整页被缩得很小，优先检查？: The entire page is tiny on a phone. What should you check first?
是否需要更多背景动画。: Whether more background animation is needed.
背景动画不会修复文字与容器的缩放关系，应先检查布局设置。: Animation does not fix the relationship between text and container scaling; inspect layout settings first.
viewport 与容器宽度、布局规则。: The viewport, container widths, and layout rules.
这些直接影响移动端的布局与缩放。: These directly affect mobile layout and scaling.
减少必要内容不是适配方案。: Removing necessary content is not a responsive-layout solution.
表单收集什么，就明确说什么: State exactly what your form collects
给表单配标签、错误说明与真实提交状态。: Give forms labels, error explanations, and truthful submission states.
如果首页需要让老师留下活动主题，表单就是把用户输入变成后续动作的界面。字段越多不: If teachers leave an activity topic on the homepage, the form turns input into a subsequent action. More fields do not automatically mean better information; explain why each is needed. A practice prototype can accept only a fictional topic, without real names, emails, or student information.
标签说明填什么，提示说明格式，校验告诉用户哪里需要改。输入框中的淡色占位文字会在: Labels say what to enter, hints explain format, and validation identifies corrections. Pale placeholders disappear during typing and cannot replace visible labels. Preserve entered content after errors and locate the message beside the relevant field rather than briefly flashing red at the page top.
最重要的是区分本地演示与真正发送。如果没有后端接收，按钮应说“检查输入”或“预览: Distinguish local demonstration from actual sending. Without a receiving backend, use “Check input” or “Preview content,” and report “Demo: not sent.” Animation does not establish submission success. When a service is added, success must follow its actual response, with failure recovery and data-handling explanations.
预测只弹出“成功”但没有请求能否收到主题；用演示表单输入空值与一条假主题，核对页: Predict whether a topic can arrive if the page says “Success” without a request. Try empty input and one fictional topic in the demo form and verify what the page really does.
给首页做一个只预览假主题的表单，补标签、空值提示和“未发送”说明；测试有效与无效: Build a homepage form that only previews a fictional topic. Add labels, an empty-input message, and a “not sent” notice. Test valid and invalid input.
每个字段有可见标签。: Every field has a visible label.
错误能定位并保留输入。: Errors are located clearly and input is preserved.
演示没有冒充真实发送。: The demonstration does not pretend to send data.
没有接收服务的原型应显示什么？: What should a prototype without a receiving service display?
已发给老师，稍后联系。: Sent to your teacher; expect contact later.
没有真实发送就不能承诺收件。: Without actual sending, receipt cannot be promised.
已建立学生档案。: A student profile has been created.
原型未实现这项能力，也不需要收学生信息。: The prototype implements no such capability and needs no student information.
本地预览完成，内容未发送。: Local preview complete; content was not sent.
状态准确描述实际行为。: The status accurately describes actual behavior.
检查用户能否真的走下去: Check whether users can actually continue
记录理解与操作问题，完成一轮有依据的修改。: Record comprehension and operation problems and complete one evidence-based revision.
让一个不了解项目的人完成任务：“找到一个你可以用在课堂里的例子，并说明需要怎么准: Ask someone unfamiliar with the project to “find an example you could use in class and explain what preparation it requires.” Observe before directing them. Record pauses, incorrect expectations, and broken links.
把问题分成内容理解、导航与实现。例如“不知道是否免费”需要补说明；“按钮点击后去: Separate content comprehension, navigation, and implementation issues. “I do not know if it is free” needs explanation; a button unexpectedly opening a repository may violate expectations; a covered mobile button is a layout defect. Address these separately instead of turning every issue into a new feature.
修改后再走同一任务。这个检查说明页面是否可理解、可操作，不等于证明工具提高了学习: After revising, repeat the task. This tests whether the page is understandable and usable, not whether the tool improves learning. Before publication, also check the accuracy of examples, sources, and status descriptions.
测试前先写下你预测访客会走的路径，再观察实际是否如此。不要急着替他的停顿找原因；: Predict the visitor's path before testing, then observe whether it happens. Do not rush to explain a pause; ask what they are looking for and distinguish interpretation from observation before deciding whether copy, entrances, or implementation needs changing.
一条可以指导修改的记录: A record that guides a revision
观察：访客点“试一试”后进入 GitHub，不知道该下载哪个文件。 解释：按钮许: Observation: “Try it” led to GitHub, where the visitor did not know which file to download. Interpretation: the button promised direct use but delivered source code. Revision: link direct use to a demo and add “View source” with a local-running note. Recheck: ask the same person to find the runnable example again.
记录至少三条观察，选一个最影响主路径的问题修复。在更新说明中写出改了什么、为什么: Record at least three observations and fix the one most affecting the primary path. In update notes, state what changed, why, and how you checked it.
测试者有具体任务，而非只问“好不好看”。: The tester has a concrete task rather than only “Does it look nice?”
我记录实际行为，并区分观察与推测。: I record actual behavior and distinguish observations from guesses.
修复后重新走过主路径。: I repeated the primary path after the fix.
访客误把源码链接当成在线演示，最直接的改动是什么？: A visitor mistakes a source-code link for an online demo. What is the most direct change?
动画无法纠正目的地与按钮预期的错位。: Animation cannot resolve the mismatch between destination and button expectation.
分别标明“在线体验”和“查看源码”，并指向相应资源。: Label “Online demo” and “View source” separately and link each to its corresponding resource.
用文字和真实目标消除误解；如果没有演示，就如实说明需要本地运行。: Align words with real destinations. If there is no demo, state that local execution is required.
相同而含糊的名称会隐藏目的地差异，增加试错。: Identical vague labels conceal destination differences and increase trial and error.
检查页面入口、状态、来源与未完成项，形成可交付说明。: Check entrances, statuses, sources, and unfinished work, and prepare handoff notes.
发布前检查是把访客看到的承诺与实际资源逐一对上。标题说能试活动，就要存在能打开的: Pre-publication checking matches each visible promise with its actual resource. If the heading promises an activity to try, an activity must open. “Download template” must provide the corresponding file. A loading homepage does not prove its branches work.
从首次来访开始检查主路径，再检查源码、来源、联系与返回入口。暂时没有的能力应明确: Start as a first-time visitor on the primary path, then check source code, references, contact, and return links. Label unavailable capabilities as planned or remove misleading entrances rather than leaving actionable-looking buttons without actions. Image alternatives should reflect purpose; decorative graphics need not repeat surrounding paragraphs.
整理更新说明：这版服务谁、提供哪些现成材料、做过什么检查、有哪些限制。把实际部署: Write update notes describing whom this version serves, available materials, checks performed, and limitations. Deployment is a separate action: this course delivers a prototype and check records, not mandatory public publication. Reuse the checklist as resources change to keep descriptions aligned with the product.
预测“体验、下载、查看源码”各会得到什么；逐个打开并记录实际目的地，解释一处预期: Predict what “Try,” “Download,” and “View source” provide. Open each and record its actual destination. Explain whether a mismatch requires changing the words or link.
完成主路径与全部链接检查，写一份交付说明；明确哪些已可用、哪些仅演示，以及尚未处: Check the primary path and all links and write handoff notes. Distinguish available features, demonstrations, and unresolved issues.
主行动到达真实目标。: The main action reaches a real destination.
来源与素材用途可核对。: Sources and material uses can be verified.
交付没有把原型说成已发布服务。: The handoff does not describe a prototype as a deployed service.
按钮目标暂未实现时，最合适的是？: A button's destination is not implemented yet. What is best?
如实标状态或移除误导入口。: Label its status accurately or remove the misleading entrance.
保持承诺与真实能力相符。: Keep promises aligned with real capabilities.
保持空按钮，期待用户不点击。: Leave an empty button and hope no one clicks.
这会直接破坏主路径预期。: That directly violates expectations on the primary path.
让工具真的能用：从一个按钮到一整套练习流程: Make a tool truly usable: from one button to a complete practice flow
围绕一张本地出门条，把一个能点的按钮做成一套完整的练习流程：状态、事件、校验、可: Build a complete practice flow around a local exit ticket, covering state, events, validation, accessibility, and local saving.
一个能预览、保存、恢复和删除假主题的本地小工具，以及完整路径检查记录。: A local tool that previews, saves, restores, and deletes fictional topics, with records covering its full paths.
做得出静态页面、想让学生真的在页面上做点什么的老师或自学者: Teachers or self-directed learners who can build a static page and want learners to do something on it
我加的按钮点两下状态就对不上，学生刚填好的东西一刷新全没了。: After two clicks, my button's state is inconsistent, and a refresh erases everything the student just entered.
一个能校验、保存、恢复和删除记录的小工具，加一份走通全部状态的检查记录。: A tool that validates, saves, restores, and deletes records, with checks walking through every state.
完成网页入门；能打开 HTML、修改少量 JavaScript，使用本地预览服务: Complete web basics; be able to open HTML, edit a little JavaScript, and use a local preview server to check storage.
互动网页是一组状态与转移: An interactive webpage is a set of states and transitions
把按钮前后发生的变化写成可检查的状态表。: Describe changes before and after a button press in a checkable state table.
静态网页主要呈现内容，互动网页会根据用户动作改变当前状态。状态是此刻页面需要记住: Static webpages primarily present content; interactive pages change their current state in response to actions. State is information the page must currently remember: whether a hint is open, whether a form is filled, or whether a record is saved. Explicitly listing it explains why the same button can produce different results at different times.
用课堂出门条做贯穿练习：老师输入活动主题，点击检查，看到可修改的预览，最后选择是: Use a classroom exit ticket throughout: a teacher enters an activity topic, clicks Check, sees an editable preview, and chooses whether to save it in this browser. List blank, editing, preview-ready, saved, and save-failed cases, then describe how actions move between them.
状态表不是为了画得复杂，而是发现漏掉的路径。若只设计成功画面，空输入、重复点击或: A state table exists to uncover missing paths, not create a complicated diagram. Designing only success screens may leave empty input, repeated clicks, and failures unexplained. This course progressively implements input, validation, feedback, keyboard use, and local records, without real student data or server submission.
预测空输入点预览会不会应该成功；用纸卡走空白→输入→预览→修改四步，指出每步需要: Predict whether Preview should succeed with empty input. Walk through blank→input→preview→revise using paper cards and identify the value retained at each step.
为虚构出门条画五个状态和三个动作，给每条转移写期望显示；用一条成功路径和一条失败: Draw five states and three actions for a fictional exit ticket. State the expected display for each transition and check one successful and one failing path.
状态描述的是信息而非颜色。: States describe information rather than colors.
空值与失败路径明确。: Empty and failure paths are explicit.
预览与保存不是同一状态。: Previewed and saved are different states.
把按钮变成绿色就能代表保存成功吗？: Does turning a button green establish successful saving?
颜色是呈现，保存成功需要实际结果。: Color is presentation; successful saving requires an actual result.
不能，需要依据保存结果更新状态。: No; update the state from the save result.
状态与底层操作结果应一致。: State should agree with the underlying operation's result.
动画不保证任何数据已写入。: Animation does not guarantee any data was written.
事件发生后，统一更新页面: Update the page consistently after an event
把数据变化与页面渲染连接起来，减少互相矛盾的显示。: Connect data changes to rendering to reduce contradictory displays.
浏览器通过事件告诉程序用户做了什么，例如点击、输入和提交。处理事件的函数可以先改: The browser reports actions through events such as clicks, input, and submission. An event handler can update data first and then call a centralized display-update function. Here, rendering means setting text, visibility, and button states from current data.
提示卡若同时在三个位置各自翻转开关，很容易出现按钮说收起但内容还在的情况。把一个: If a hint card independently toggles a switch in three places, the button may say “Hidden” while content remains visible. Use one Boolean as the expansion-state source and a render function to update hidden, text, and aria-expanded together, reducing divergence among state copies.
集中更新不是任何项目都必须照搬的框架，而是小页面也能使用的整理方式。事件监听应在: Centralized updating is an organizational technique for small pages, not a framework every project must copy. Set listeners after elements exist; when an element is missing, check IDs and script placement first. After editing, click twice and retest with a keyboard rather than checking only the first reveal.
先预测只改按钮文字会留下哪处矛盾；将展开值分别映射到内容可见、标签和 aria-: Predict the inconsistency left by changing only button text. Map the expanded value to content visibility, label, and aria-expanded, toggle twice, and explain the consistency.
把现有提示卡整理成一个状态值和一个 render 函数；保留原功能，检查打开、收: Organize the existing hint card around one state value and one render function. Preserve behavior and check opening, collapsing, and keyboard use.
只有清楚的展开状态来源。: There is one clear source for expansion state.
多个显示由同一状态推导。: Related displays derive from the same state.
事件绑定时元素已经存在。: Elements exist when event handlers are attached.
怎样减少按钮文字与内容可见性的冲突？: How can you reduce conflicts between button text and content visibility?
分别随意改变每个位置。: Change every display independently and arbitrarily.
多处独立判断更容易不一致。: Separate independent judgments are more likely to diverge.
隐藏按钮取消了用户切换提示的入口，却没有整理状态逻辑。: That removes the entrance for toggling hints without organizing state logic.
从同一个状态值更新相关显示。: Update related displays from the same state value.
让相关呈现共享明确依据。: Related presentations share an explicit basis.
表单：标签、输入与提交是一组: Forms: labels, input, and submission belong together
使用原生表单结构，让鼠标与键盘都能完成输入。: Use native form structure so both mouse and keyboard can complete input.
表单是一组收集输入并提交处理的控件。label 为输入框提供可见名称，input: A form groups controls that collect input for processing. label gives a field a visible name, input or textarea accepts content, and button triggers an action. A teacher entering an activity topic should not have to guess a placeholder's meaning or interpret a nearby color.
让 label 的 for 对应输入框的 id，可以建立明确关联。处理 form: Matching a label's for with the field's id establishes their relationship. Handle the form's submit event rather than only mouse clicks because users may submit with Enter. In this local prototype, prevent default submission navigation and display a preview on the page.
HTML 结构本身不会自动建立数据库，也不会把内容发给同事。你需要明确处理发生在: HTML structure does not automatically create a database or send content to colleagues. State where processing occurs. Use the fictional topic “Observe school plants” and label the page as a local preview so its form does not imply a real registration or collection system.
不用鼠标也能提交吗？: Can you submit without a mouse?
先预测点按钮与输入后按 Enter 是否走同一逻辑；分别尝试，检查标签点击是否聚: Predict whether clicking the button and pressing Enter after typing use the same logic. Try both, check that clicking the label focuses the field, and explain the form's role.
<form id=\"activity-form\"> <label for=\: Content will not be sent.
创建含一个主题输入框的表单，用 submit 处理显示预览；测试标签、Enter: Create a form with one topic field and a submit handler that displays a preview. Test the label, Enter, and button paths.
label 正确关联字段。: The label is correctly associated with its field.
页面说明数据没有发送。: The page states that data is not sent.
只给按钮绑 click，可能遗漏什么？: What might be missed by attaching only a button click handler?
这是样式问题，不是事件入口。: That is styling, not an event entrance.
问题通常是行为路径覆盖不足。: The usual issue is incomplete behavioral-path coverage.
校验：告诉用户哪一处可以改: Validation: tell users what they can correct
区分空值检查、格式校验与内容真实性。: Distinguish empty-input checks, format validation, and factual truth.
校验是检查输入是否符合当前处理要求，例如必填字段不能空着、长度不能超出约定。它帮: Validation checks whether input meets processing requirements, such as a required field or an agreed length limit. It helps users correct input; it does not judge an educational topic's quality or establish that an email belongs to its submitter. Valid format and truthful content are different issues.
先用原生 required 等约束，再根据场景补自定义规则。主题输入只有空格时，: Begin with native constraints such as required, adding custom rules as needed. A whitespace-only topic can be trimmed and treated as empty; say “Enter an activity topic” and direct attention to the field. Retaining the original input makes correction easier than clearing everything.
客户端校验发生在浏览器，未来若有服务器接收，服务器仍需重新检查，因为浏览器规则可: Client-side validation happens in the browser. If a server is added later, it must check again because browser rules can be bypassed. This local exercise checks blank, normal, and overly long text. Each rule needs a clear purpose rather than arbitrarily restricting expression to appear strict.
空格算填写了吗？: Do spaces count as a response?
预测输入三个空格能否通过只看长度的检查；比较原值与 trim 后结果，再说明为什: Predict whether three spaces pass a length-only check. Compare the original value and the trimmed result, then explain why characters do not necessarily constitute meaningful content.
为主题字段定义空白与长度规则，写对应可修改提示；逐个测试三种输入，并确认错误后原: Define blank and length rules for the topic field, with actionable messages. Test each of three input types and confirm that the original text remains after an error.
空格与过长输入都试过。: Whitespace and overly long input have both been tried.
格式通过没有被称为事实审核。: Passing a format check is not called fact-checking.
一个邮箱满足格式，说明什么？: An email address meets the format rule. What does that establish?
一定是真实本人且可以联系。: It certainly belongs to the person and can receive mail.
格式检查不能验证身份与送达。: A format check does not verify identity or delivery.
只满足当前格式规则，真实性需别的证据。: Only that it meets current format rules; authenticity needs other evidence.
检查结论应限制在规则覆盖的范围。: The conclusion must stay within what the rule checks.
客户端规则不能替代服务端检查。: Client-side rules cannot replace server-side checks.
让等待、成功和失败都说实话: Tell the truth about waiting, success, and failure
根据实际处理结果提供可行动反馈，并保留恢复路径。: Provide actionable feedback based on actual results and preserve a recovery path.
用户按下按钮以后，需要知道系统是否收到动作、还在处理，还是已经完成。反馈不仅是一: After pressing a button, users need to know whether the system received the action, is processing it, or finished. Feedback is more than praise: it should state the current condition and next step. After saving fails, “Copy your content, then retry” supports progress better than a red cross alone.
如果操作需要时间，可以显示正在处理，并暂时避免重复提交；真正完成后才显示成功。不: If processing takes time, display that state and temporarily avoid duplicate submissions; report success only after actual completion. A fixed one-second animation is not evidence of service success. Demonstrations may manually switch success and failure, but must identify the simulation and absence of a real request.
状态文字应出现在用户能够找到的位置，必要时用 role=\"status\" 等: Place status text where users can find it and use semantics such as role="status" when appropriate so assistive technology notices updates. Avoid repeatedly interrupting input. Preserve content after failure and explain retry conditions. After recovery, check for duplicate saving rather than assuming a recovered display means correct data.
先预测加载动画结束是否意味着请求成功；用纸卡或演示开关选择成功与失败，观察反馈变: Predict whether a loading animation ending means a request succeeded. Select success or failure with paper cards or a demo switch, observe the messages, and distinguish result evidence from animation timing.
为预览或保存动作写处理中、成功、失败三条消息及下一步；模拟失败并确认输入保留，明: Write processing, success, and failure messages with next steps for previewing or saving. Simulate failure, confirm input remains, and label the simulation.
失败后有可执行下一步。: Failure offers an actionable next step.
状态可被看见并被辅助技术理解。: Status is visible and understandable to assistive technology.
请求失败后最有帮助的反馈是？: What feedback is most helpful after a failed request?
成功完成，避免让用户担心。: Successfully completed, to avoid worrying users.
虚假成功会造成数据与预期不一致。: False success creates a mismatch between data and expectations.
未知错误，然后清空全部输入。: Unknown error, then erase all input.
既没有恢复方法，也增加重复劳动。: That provides no recovery and creates repeated work.
未能保存，保留输入并说明复制或重试方法。: Could not save; retain input and explain copying or retrying.
准确状态和恢复路径能帮助继续任务。: Accurate status and a recovery path help users continue.
可访问性从真实键盘路径开始: Begin accessibility with a real keyboard journey
让更多人能用: Make it usable for more people
验证焦点、标签与原生控件，避免把无鼠标用户挡在流程外。: Verify focus, labels, and native controls so users without a mouse can complete the flow.
可访问性关注不同能力、设备与操作方式的人能否使用页面。键盘检查是一个实用起点：按: Accessibility concerns use across abilities, devices, and interaction methods. Keyboard checking is a practical start: Tab reaches controls in order, focus remains visible, and Enter or Space triggers native behavior. It is not a complete accessibility evaluation.
使用真正的按钮、链接和表单控件，比给普通文字加点击事件更容易获得正确基础行为。展: Actual buttons, links, and form controls provide better baseline behavior than click handlers on ordinary text. When a hint expands, aria-expanded should match its display. Adding ARIA attributes without corresponding behavior does not automatically create an accessible component.
从页面顶部走完整个出门条流程，检查错误出现后是否知道修改哪里、收起区域有没有留下: Walk through the exit-ticket flow from the page top. After errors, is it clear what to fix? Do collapsed areas leave focus on invisible controls? Also check contrast, zoom, and image alternatives. Automated tools and keyboard checks cover different things; state what was checked rather than claiming comprehensive compliance.
先预测能否不借助鼠标完成填写、预览和保存；按实际焦点顺序操作，记录一次卡住位置，: Predict whether you can enter, preview, and save without a mouse. Follow the actual focus order, record one obstruction, and explain whether it concerns element role or focus visibility.
只用键盘走完整条主路径，修复一个不可达或焦点不清楚的位置；再放大页面检查文字与按: Complete the primary path with a keyboard, repair one unreachable control or unclear focus indicator, then zoom the page and check text and buttons.
焦点可见且顺序合理。: Focus is visible and ordered logically.
没有把一次走查当完整认证。: One walkthrough is not described as full certification.
给 div 加 aria-label 就自动具备按钮行为吗？: Does aria-label on a div automatically provide button behavior?
不会，还缺键盘与语义行为，优先用 button。: No; keyboard and semantic behavior are still missing. Prefer button.
可访问名称不是完整交互实现。: An accessible name is not a complete interaction implementation.
会，任何属性都会自动绑定按键。: Yes; any attribute automatically binds keys.
ARIA 本身不实现事件行为。: ARIA itself does not implement event behavior.
会自动提交到服务器。: It automatically submits to a server.
标签与网络请求没有这种关系。: Labels and network requests have no such relationship.
本地存储：刷新后仍在，但只在这里: Local storage: still here after refresh, but only here
把保存操作与实际结果连接，理解同源与浏览器边界。: Tie saving to actual results and understand origin and browser boundaries.
普通变量在刷新后重新开始，本地存储可以让小量文字在同一站点的当前浏览器中继续存在: Ordinary variables restart on refresh; local storage can retain small amounts of text for the same site in the current browser. localStorage stores string keys and values: a key names the record, and a value holds its content. It is not an account system and does not automatically synchronize devices.
为出门条使用独立键，如 activity-draft-v1，保存前说明范围。读取: Use a dedicated exit-ticket key such as activity-draft-v1 and explain the scope before saving. Both reads and writes may fail, so catch errors with try/catch and display truthful messages. Storage behavior for directly opened file: pages is not uniformly guaranteed; local HTTP is better for reliable testing.
保存之后刷新并核对，再修改内容而不保存，观察刷新后恢复的是哪一版。删除只针对本工: Save, refresh, and compare. Then edit without saving and observe which version returns after refresh. Delete only this tool's key to avoid affecting other site records. Storage is not a secure vault, and this exercise should not hold real student information; its purpose is understanding the record lifecycle.
保存前后刷新有什么不同？: What differs when you refresh before versus after saving?
先预测输入但未保存与保存后刷新各恢复什么；按两种路径测试，解释“界面里有字”和“: Predict what returns after typing without saving and after saving. Test both paths and explain the difference between text visible in the interface and text written to storage.
为假主题实现保存、读取和删除；测试未保存刷新、已保存刷新、删除刷新和失败提示，记: Implement saving, reading, and deleting a fictional topic. Test unsaved refresh, saved refresh, refresh after deletion, and failure messages, recording actual results.
保存成功依据写入结果。: Save success follows the write result.
知道本地范围与失败情况。: I understand the local scope and failure cases.
换浏览器看不到草稿，最可能因为？: Why is a draft probably missing in a different browser?
本例只操作浏览器存储，没有上传请求或云端同步服务。: This example only uses browser storage; it has no upload request or cloud synchronization service.
记录仅在原浏览器的对应站点存储中。: The record exists only in the original browser's storage for that site.
本地保存与跨设备同步不同。: Local saving differs from cross-device synchronization.
一定是用户记错主题。: The user must have misremembered the topic.

GitHub 是协作平台，账号是你的身份: GitHub is a collaboration platform; your account is your identity
区分本地版本工具、平台账号与仓库权限。: Distinguish local version-control tools, platform accounts, and repository permissions.
GitHub 是保存远端仓库、讨论问题和审阅修改的平台。Git 是本地记录版本的: GitHub hosts remote repositories, issue discussions, and change reviews. Git records versions locally. They commonly work together but are not identical. Registering on GitHub does not automatically upload computer files, and installing Git does not grant write permission to a repository.

理解读取与写入权限不同。: I understand that read and write permissions differ.

否，平台账号需要单独建立。: No; the platform account is created separately.
本地版本工具与平台身份是不同层。: Local version control and platform identity are different layers.
账号就是电脑文件夹名称。: The account is the computer folder's name.
账号标识平台身份，目录只是本地位置。: An account identifies you on the platform; a directory is a local location.

Fork 是在 GitHub 上建立与上游项目有关联的派生仓库，通常放到你有管理: A fork creates a derivative repository on GitHub associated with an upstream project, usually under an account you control. 能指出三份副本分别在哪里。: I can locate all three copies.

派生仓库的变化不会自动写进上游。: Fork changes are not automatically written upstream.
Fork 并不移走原项目。: Forking does not move away the original project.
通常仍保持原样，需另行提出并接受修改。: It generally stays unchanged until a separate change is proposed and accepted.
上游接收是独立的协作决定。: Upstream acceptance is an independent collaboration decision.
提交留在本地，推送才到远端: Commits stay local; pushing sends them to a remote
理解 commit、push、fetch 的边界，先核对远端再共享。: Understand commit, push, and fetch boundaries and verify the remote before sharing.
本地提交保存电脑仓库里的版本，push 把指定分支的提交发送到远端仓库。orig: A local commit saves a version in the repository on your computer; push sends commits from a specified branch to a remote repository. origin is a conventional alias, not a guarantee it points to your account. 箭头何时真正越过网络？: When does the arrow actually cross the network?
预测 commit 后另一台电脑是否能看到新内容；提交前后看平台页面，再推送并刷: Predict whether another computer can see new content after a commit. Inspect the platform before and after committing, then push and refresh. Explain local history versus remote synchronization.

推送前核对 origin 的实际地址。: I verify origin's actual URL before pushing.
只共享已审阅的练习内容。: I share only reviewed practice content.
在平台目标分支验证到达。: I verify arrival on the platform's target branch.
fetch 后当前文件没变，是否一定失败？: After fetch, current files are unchanged. Does that necessarily mean failure?
不是，fetch 主要获取远端记录供后续整合。: No; fetch mainly retrieves remote records for later integration.
获取与修改当前分支是可以分开的。: Retrieval and modifying the current branch can be separate.
文件未变可能符合 fetch 的正常行为。: Unchanged files may be normal fetch behavior.
说明全部本地提交都丢失。: All local commits must be lost.

Issue：把一个问题讲到别人能行动: Issues: describe a problem so someone can act
写出带复现、期望与范围的问题记录。: Write an issue with reproduction steps, expectations, and scope.
Issue 是仓库里跟踪问题、需求或任务的讨论条目。它不是代码修改本身，也不是给: An Issue tracks a problem, request, or task in a repository discussion. It is not a code change or an automatic command to maintainers. A clear Issue explains what needs addressing, why it matters, and what completion would look like.

一条 Issue 聚焦一个问题。: One Issue focuses on one problem.
别人能依描述执行检查。: Another person can run checks from the description.

来源和目标分支明确。: Source and target branches are explicit.
PR 描述有真实验证记录。: The PR description includes actual validation records.
理解提出 PR 尚未合并。: I understand that opening a PR does not merge it.
PR 已创建后，目标分支是否一定更新？: Does creating a PR necessarily update the target branch?
提出与接受修改是两个步骤。: Proposing and accepting a change are separate steps.
不一定，还要经过接收与合并。: No; acceptance and merging are still required.
目标分支不会仅因讨论入口创建就接纳改动。: A discussion entrance alone does not incorporate changes into the target branch.
只有换仓库名才会更新。: It updates only after renaming the repository.

报告不是命令，也不自动同步文件。: Reports are not commands and do not automatically synchronize files.
提交或 PR 能定位到实际改动。: The commit or PR locates actual changes.
未测试和待确认事项没有被省略。: Untested items and open questions are not omitted.

报告需要与真实状态核对。: Reports must be checked against real state.

Complete Git and web basics and have a working practice page. Automated assertion examples require installed Node.js; read its official instructions first.
重构改变内部组织，保留约定行为: Refactoring changes internal organization while preserving agreed behavior
区分重构、修复缺陷与新增功能，说明保持什么不变。: Distinguish refactoring, bug fixes, and new features, and specify what must stay unchanged.
重构是调整程序内部结构，同时保持对外可观察行为不变。例如把提示按钮的重复显示逻辑: Refactoring reorganizes a program internally while preserving externally observable behavior. For example, consolidate duplicate hint-display logic into one function while users still open and collapse it the same way. It does not mean replacing the whole page or casually changing learning-activity rules.
修复缺陷会有意改变错误行为，新增功能则增加新的使用方式。它们都可能有价值，但若与: A bug fix intentionally changes incorrect behavior; a feature adds a new way to use the product. Both can be valuable, but mixing them with a large refactor makes causes hard to identify when problems appear. Specify the one part being reorganized this round and give other requests separate tasks.
AI 很擅长给出整段改写，但你负责定义不变的部分和检查方法。本课程用已能运行的提: AI readily proposes wholesale rewrites, but you define the invariants and checks. Practice on a working hint card: preserve initially hidden content, first-click expansion, second-click collapse, and keyboard operation while organizing code gradually and learning to detect regressions and restore a known version.
看起来一样，就一定没变吗？: If it looks the same, must it be unchanged?
预测重构后截图相同能否证明按钮行为相同；分别点击两次并用键盘操作，解释静态外观覆: Predict whether identical screenshots after refactoring prove identical button behavior. Click twice and operate with a keyboard, explaining which states a static appearance does not cover.
选择一小段提示卡代码，写“要整理什么”“必须不变什么”“本轮不加什么”，保留一个: Choose a small hint-card code section and state what to organize, what must stay unchanged, and what not to add. Keep a working copy.
能区分三种改动目的。: I distinguish three purposes of change.
不变行为具体到操作结果。: Unchanged behavior is specified as action results.
选的是已经能工作的练习页面。: The selected practice page already works.
把提示改为自动弹出并称为纯重构，准确吗？: You make hints appear automatically and call it a pure refactor. Is that accurate?
准确，只要代码更短。: Yes, provided the code is shorter.
触发方式已改变，是可观察行为变化。: The trigger changed, which is observable behavior.
不准确，它改变了用户使用方式。: No; it changes how users interact.
重构需保持约定外部行为，新增规则应另说明。: A refactor preserves agreed external behavior; new rules need separate explanation.
取决于按钮颜色。: It depends on the button color.
行为是否改变与颜色无关。: Whether behavior changed is unrelated to color.
先保存一个真实可运行的起点: Save an actually working starting point first
记录环境、当前问题与检查结果，建立可比较的基线。: Record environment, current issues, and check results to establish a comparable baseline.
基线是修改前已经确认的状态。它包括具体版本、运行方法和观察结果，而不只是“以前应: A baseline is a confirmed pre-change state, including a specific version, startup method, and observations—not merely “it used to work.” Record any already-broken button first, or you may mistake an old defect for a new regression or falsely claim everything remains correct.
先查看 Git 状态与当前分支，读未提交差异，分清哪些是自己的修改。对练习项目留: Inspect Git status, current branch, and uncommitted diffs, identifying your changes. Save a clear practice-project commit before creating a refactor branch. Do not delete unfamiliar files or others' uncommitted work to get a clean status. If scope is unclear, remain at inspection and recording until understood.
打开提示卡，完成初始、展开、收起、刷新与键盘五项检查，写实际结果。也记录浏览器与: Open the hint card and check initial state, expansion, collapse, refresh, and keyboard operation, recording real results plus browser and URL. Repeat comparisons under the same conditions to relate differences to this change. A saved screenshot is only part of the baseline.
先坏的还是后来坏的？: Was it already broken, or did it break later?
预测没有修改前记录时能否判断“收起无效”从何时开始；先做五项检查，再故意在副本制: Predict whether you can date a collapse failure without pre-change records. Run the five checks first, then deliberately introduce a difference in a copy and explain the baseline's role.
记录当前提交、分支、启动方式和五项实际结果；保留清楚基线后再新建练习重构分支。: Record the current commit, branch, startup method, and five actual results. Create a practice refactor branch only after preserving a clear baseline.
未提交工作归属清楚。: Ownership of uncommitted work is clear.
发现工作区有不认识的改动，应该？: You find unfamiliar changes in the working tree. What should you do?
全部删除以便开始。: Delete all of them to begin.
可能破坏他人或用户尚未提交的工作。: That may destroy another person's or the user's uncommitted work.
直接把它们算成本次重构。: Automatically count them as part of this refactor.
未确认来源就纳入本次提交，会混淆已有工作与重构产生的变化。: Including changes before confirming their origin confuses existing work with refactor changes.
先查看差异并确认来源，保护现有工作。: Inspect the diff and confirm its origin while protecting existing work.
建立可靠基线需要理解当前状态。: A reliable baseline requires understanding the current state.
把笼统要求变成输入、动作与预期结果。: Turn broad requirements into inputs, actions, and expected results.
“保持所有功能”过于宽泛，难以验收。行为约定可以写成具体例子：刚打开页面时提示隐: “Keep all features” is too broad to verify. A behavior contract uses examples: the hint starts hidden, pressing the button reveals it and changes the label to Hide, and pressing again restores the initial state. These tell AI and reviewers what must not break.
还应包含容易漏掉的边界，例如重复操作、空输入、键盘触发和刷新。对于本地反思卡，存: Include easily missed boundaries such as repeated actions, empty input, keyboard activation, and refresh. For a local reflection card, storage key names and formats may also be external contracts: renaming a key can hide existing notes even if the new page looks fine.
约定不必覆盖整个项目，先覆盖本轮会触及的部分与相邻路径。把已知错误另列，避免为了: The contract need not cover the whole project; first cover the part touched and neighboring paths. List known errors separately so “preserving behavior” does not permanently define defects as correct. If fixing a bug simultaneously, explicitly state the changed expectation and verify it separately.
一张行为表比一句保证多了什么？: What does a behavior table add beyond a promise?
先预测“保持功能”能否发现第二次点击失败；用输入、动作、期望三列表重写要求，实际: Predict whether “keep functionality” catches a second-click failure. Rewrite requirements as input, action, and expectation columns, click twice, and explain the difference.
为提示卡写五条行为约定，其中两条覆盖重复或恢复；若有存储，注明要保留的键与格式。: Write five hint-card behavior contracts, including two for repetition or recovery. If storage is involved, identify keys and formats to preserve.
约定能由别人执行。: Another person can execute the contract.
覆盖本轮触及的边界。: It covers boundaries touched in this round.
已知缺陷与期望行为区分。: Known defects are separated from expected behavior.
重构时换了存储键导致旧笔记消失，属于？: A refactor changes a storage key and old notes disappear. What is this?
正常，因为只是改名字。: Normal; it only changes a name.
名字影响了用户可见数据，已超出纯内部变化。: The name affects user-visible data, so it is more than an internal change.
破坏了需保留的数据兼容行为。: A violation of required data-compatibility behavior.
外部约定也包括已有记录能否继续读取。: External contracts include continued access to existing records.
给 AI 一次只够做一步的任务: Give AI a task small enough for one step
用文件范围、不变条件与停点约束一次可检查的修改。: Constrain one checkable edit through file scope, invariants, and review points.
一次让 AI“把项目全面优化”，常会得到大量无法快速核对的改动。更可控的任务是“: “Optimize the entire project” often produces more changes than you can quickly verify. A controlled task is “extract only the hint card's display updates into a function, preserving HTML, button text, and all behavior.” Clear scope makes extra or missing work easier to spot.
任务说明应给现有文件、问题原因、不变条件和检查方式，要求它先读当前实现再提出最小: Provide current files, the internal problem, invariants, and checks, asking AI to read the implementation before proposing the smallest change. If multiple modules must change, explain dependencies first rather than casually upgrading dependencies or rewriting architecture. Proceed after each step passes.
这里的停点是便于你读差异与运行检查，不是让 AI 反复问一句没有信息的“要继续吗: These review points let you read diffs and run checks; they are not repeated, empty “Continue?” questions. You can authorize the checklist in advance and require evidence at each step. Record out-of-scope discoveries for later so the current task stays explainable.
预测“全面优化”与“只提取 renderHint”各会触及多少文件；对照实际方案: Predict the file scope of “optimize everything” versus “extract only renderHint.” Compare the actual proposals and explain which changes are necessary for this step.
写一份小重构说明：目标文件、内部问题、五条不变行为和验收步骤；让 AI 或自己只: Write a small refactor brief with target file, internal problem, five behavioral invariants, and acceptance steps. Have AI or yourself complete only the first step.
任务指向具体文件与结构。: The task identifies specific files and structure.
AI 顺便重写整个页面，下一步应该？: AI rewrites the entire page as an extra. What should you do next?
改动量不等于价值，也提高核对负担。: Change volume is not value and increases verification effort.
范围进一步扩大更难判断回归。: Further scope expansion makes regressions harder to judge.
对照约定收窄范围，先验收必要的一步。: Return to the contract, narrow scope, and verify the necessary step first.
保持任务与差异可对应，才能可靠推进。: Matching tasks to diffs enables reliable progress.
把重复决定提取成有名字的函数: Extract repeated decisions into a named function
识别共同逻辑，定义明确输入与返回值。: Identify shared logic with explicit inputs and return values.
函数把一组可重复的步骤放进有名字的单元。提取函数时，先看重复的究竟是同一个决定，: A function groups repeatable steps under a name. Before extracting one, determine whether duplicated code makes the same decision or only looks similar. “Choose text and visibility from expansion state” is a clear hint-card responsibility worth expressing separately.
可以让 hintView 接收一个布尔值，返回标签、隐藏状态与展开属性。这样不碰: Let hintView accept a Boolean and return the label, hidden state, and expansion attribute. You can compare true and false outputs without touching the page, then apply them through rendering code. Explicit inputs and outputs are easier to inspect than a function silently changing unrelated variables.
不要为了减少行数把所有逻辑塞进一个万能函数。一个名字应说明它解决什么问题，调用处: Do not put all logic into one universal function merely to reduce lines. A name should express the problem it solves, and callers should remain readable. Check return values after extraction, then the actual button flow: a correct function does not guarantee correct call placement or update order.
把两个状态放进同一张表: Put both states in one table
预测 false 与 true 应返回哪组显示值；运行下面函数两次，把结果与原按: Predict the display values for false and true, run the function below twice, and compare with the original button. Explain what the function does not handle.
提取一个只决定提示显示信息的函数，分别检查两种输入；再接回已有页面并走两次点击。: Extract a function that only determines hint-display information and check both inputs. Reconnect it to the page and click twice.
函数职责可以一句话说明。: The function's responsibility fits one sentence.
输入与返回值明确。: Inputs and return values are explicit.
接回页面后重新验证行为。: Behavior is reverified after reconnecting it to the page.
一个函数需要读取十个全局变量才知道做什么，主要问题是？: A function must read ten globals before its purpose is clear. What is the main problem?
行为依赖隐藏，较难理解和检查。: Hidden behavioral dependencies make it harder to understand and check.
应考虑收窄职责并显式传入必要信息。: Consider narrowing its responsibility and passing required information explicitly.
函数永远不适合重构。: Functions are never appropriate for refactoring.
函数是组织逻辑的一种常用方式。: Functions are a common way to organize logic.
分开内容、状态和显示职责: Separate content, state, and display responsibilities
识别数据、行为与呈现的边界，避免过度拆分。: Identify data, behavior, and presentation boundaries without excessive splitting.
活动题目和参考是内容，当前选哪张卡是状态，把文字放到页面是显示职责。它们全部混在: Activity questions and references are content; the selected card is state; placing text on the page is display work. When all are mixed in one event handler, editing a question may touch storage or button behavior. Moderate separation makes change scope clearer.
先在同一文件里用命名分区或小函数区分职责，再在确有需要时拆文件。模块是可以导出、: Begin with named sections or small functions in the same file, splitting files when there is a real need. A module exports and imports functionality; browser module scripts generally need local HTTP testing rather than assuming double-clicked files always work.
拆分不是越细越好。三张卡的小工具不需要为了“专业”变成几十个文件。以实际变化为依: Finer splitting is not always better. A three-card tool does not need dozens of files to appear professional. Follow actual changes: replacing material should mainly affect data, while changing presentation should avoid record identities. Preserve IDs, storage formats, and user paths, and recheck imports after splitting.
换题目会不会碰到保存逻辑？: Will changing a question touch the save logic?
预测内容写在事件函数里与独立数据对象里，改题目各需经过哪些地方；标出职责边界，解: Predict which locations change when content sits inside an event function versus a separate data object. Mark responsibility boundaries and explain which makes scope easier to control.
在现有文件中标出内容、状态、显示、存储四类代码；只整理一处混杂职责，不急着增加文: Identify content, state, display, and storage code in the existing file. Organize one mixed responsibility without rushing to increase file count.
拆分对应真实修改需求。: Separation corresponds to actual editing needs.
卡片 ID 和存储格式保持兼容。: Card IDs and storage formats stay compatible.
没有用文件数量衡量质量。: Quality is not measured by file count.
重构后文件更多，是否一定更好？: Are more files after refactoring necessarily better?
一定，文件数量代表架构质量。: Yes; file count measures architecture quality.
过度拆分也会增加查找与连接成本。: Excessive splitting also increases navigation and coordination costs.
不一定，应看职责是否更清楚且行为保持。: No; examine whether responsibilities are clearer and behavior is preserved.
组织价值取决于理解与维护效果。: Organizational value depends on understanding and maintenance.
必须全部回到一行代码。: Everything must be compressed back into one line.
用少量针对风险的断言捕捉回归，并知道测试覆盖的边界。: Use a few risk-focused assertions to catch regressions and understand their coverage limits.
测试把预期写成可以重复执行的检查。断言是其中的判断：实际结果应该等于哪个值，不相: Tests encode expectations as repeatable checks. An assertion compares an actual result with an expected value and reports a failure when they differ. For hintView, check both collapsed and expanded outputs so internal rewrites can quickly be checked for behavioral changes.
好测试关注使用约定，而不是复制实现的每一行。若测试也抄同一段错误逻辑，二者可能一: Good tests focus on usage contracts rather than duplicating implementation line by line. If tests copy the same faulty logic, both can be wrong together. Derive expectations independently from requirements, then run them. Deliberately break one return value in a practice copy to confirm the test fails, then restore it.
函数测试通过不代表网页全部正常，还可能有事件没绑定、焦点丢失或 CSS 覆盖隐藏: Passing function tests does not establish the whole page works: events may be unbound, focus lost, or CSS overriding hidden content. Automated checks and a manual primary path complement each other. Prefer an existing project's tests rather than building a large framework for a low-risk wording edit; built-in assertions demonstrate the minimal mechanism here.
让测试真的失败一次: Make a test fail once on purpose
先预测把 hidden 的取反去掉会让哪条检查失败；在练习副本改坏、运行并恢复，: Predict which check fails if hidden no longer negates the state. Break a practice copy, run and restore it, and connect the failure to a user behavior.
把 hintView 放入 hint-test.mjs，加入下面 Node 内置: Place hintView in hint-test.mjs, add the Node built-in assertions below, and run node hint-test.mjs. Observe success, deliberately introduce an error to verify detection, then restore the code.
至少观察过一次有意失败。: I observed at least one intentional failure.
函数测试与浏览器走查都做。: Both function tests and browser walkthroughs were completed.
两个函数测试通过以后，还需要什么？: After both function tests pass, what else is needed?
函数测试未覆盖 DOM、事件和焦点等连接。: Function tests do not cover DOM, event, and focus connections.
测试结论只限已覆盖情境。: Test conclusions apply only to covered cases.
在实际页面验证连接后的主路径。: Verify the connected primary path in the actual page.
集成与用户操作可能暴露另一些问题。: Integration and user operation can expose other problems.
读差异，找出没有被测试照亮的地方: Read the diff to find what tests do not illuminate
结合改动范围与行为检查，识别意外删除和语义变化。: Combine change scope and behavioral checks to identify accidental deletions and semantic changes.
差异审阅让你看到这一步真正改变了什么。先按文件范围检查，再读关键增删：有没有丢掉: Diff review reveals what this step really changed. Check file scope, then key additions and deletions: were labels, error handling, storage versions, or keyboard semantics lost? AI's summary can guide navigation, but actual files and runtime results are the evidence.
比如重构后删除 aria-expanded，鼠标点击仍可能正常，简单函数测试也可: For example, deleting aria-expanded may leave mouse clicks and simple function tests working while reducing state information for assistive technology. Testing only expansion can miss collapse failures or inconsistent labels. Add checks for usage methods the change may affect.
问题记录写位置、影响与重现方法，区分必须修的行为破坏和个人风格偏好。修复后重跑相: Report location, impact, and reproduction, separating required behavior repairs from personal style preferences. Rerun relevant checks after fixes before accepting the step. If the diff is too large to understand, split the change rather than trusting everything because the page still lights up.
一行删除为何重要？: Why can deleting one line matter?
预测删除 aria-expanded 会不会影响鼠标截图；比较鼠标行为和元素语义: Predict whether removing aria-expanded changes a mouse screenshot. Compare mouse behavior with element semantics and explain which usage condition “looks the same” misses.
阅读本步全部差异，找一项测试可能未覆盖的行为，补一次定向检查；写出结果与是否接受: Read the whole step's diff, identify one behavior tests may not cover, and add a targeted check. Record its result and why you accept or reject the step.
审阅范围包括语义与失败处理。: Review includes semantics and failure handling.
问题反馈有具体影响。: Issue feedback explains a concrete impact.
没有仅凭 AI 总结接受。: Acceptance does not rely solely on AI's summary.
鼠标操作正常但键盘失效，属于什么？: Mouse operation works, but keyboard operation fails. What is this?
原有操作方式被破坏，属于行为回归。: Breaking an existing interaction method is a behavioral regression.
需要修复的约定行为变化。: A change to agreed behavior that needs fixing.
行为不变包括已支持的输入方式。: Preserving behavior includes already-supported input methods.
证明重构效果更好。: Proof that the refactor is better.
少支持一种使用方式不是内部整理成果。: Removing a supported usage method is not an internal organization improvement.
无法确认时，退回已知可用版本: When uncertain, return to a known working version
选择与提交状态相符的回退方式，并验证恢复结果。: Choose a rollback appropriate to commit state and verify recovery.
回退计划让重构可以停在已知状态，不必为了维护已经花掉的时间继续叠加补丁。开始前就: A rollback plan lets refactoring stop at a known state instead of adding patches to justify sunk effort. Record the baseline commit and step boundary before starting. On failure, preserve the issue description and needed diff before deciding which layer to undo; do not blindly discard the entire working tree.
尚未提交的改动与已共享提交需要不同处理。对于已提交且共享的一次普通重构，可以用: Uncommitted changes and shared commits require different handling. For an ordinary refactor commit already shared, revert creates an inverse commit that records both the change and reversal. If only staging selection is wrong, adjust staging without discarding file content.
回退也需要检查：页面能否重新打开、旧记录是否还能读、问题是否真的消失。若基线本来: Rollback also needs checking: does the page open again, can old records be read, and is the problem really gone? Restoring a defective baseline does not magically fix its defects. Put the failure's cause into a smaller next task so rollback captures a learned boundary rather than hiding an error.
预测反向提交能否保证所有运行环境都恢复；在练习仓库回退一条自己的普通提交，重走基: Predict whether a reverse commit guarantees recovery in every runtime environment. Revert one of your own ordinary practice commits, repeat the baseline paths, and explain recovery scope.
写一份回退步骤，标明目标提交、需保护的工作和恢复后检查；在练习仓库演练一次并记录: Write rollback steps identifying the target commit, protected work, and post-recovery checks. Rehearse once in the practice repository and record results.
回退目标清楚且不混入他人工作。: The rollback target is clear and excludes others' work.
选择了适合当前提交状态的方式。: The method fits the current commit state.
恢复后实际运行并检查数据。: I actually run the page and check data after recovery.
命令没有红字就够了。: No red command output is enough.
命令执行与用户行为恢复仍需核对。: Command execution and restored user behavior still need comparison.
这会丢失后续定位依据。: That removes evidence useful for later diagnosis.
目标版本恢复且相关行为重新通过检查。: The target version is restored and relevant behaviors pass checks again.
版本和运行表现都与回退目标对应。: Both version and runtime performance match the rollback goal.
交付能继续维护的重构结果: Deliver a refactor others can maintain
说明内部改善、不变行为、测试证据和剩余风险。: Explain internal improvements, preserved behavior, test evidence, and remaining risks.
重构交付要让后来的人知道内部为何更容易理解，同时知道外部哪些行为保持了。说明“把: A refactor handoff should explain why the internals are easier to understand and which external behaviors remain. “Moved repeated hint-display decisions into hintView, shared by two callers” is more specific and checkable than “comprehensively improved code quality.”
列出基线与最终提交、修改文件、执行过的测试和人工路径结果。未测试的浏览器、仍存在: List baseline and final commits, modified files, executed tests, and manual-path results. Separate untested browsers, existing defects, and future features. “All tests green” does not cover unconfigured areas, and a refactor should not be presented as improved learning effectiveness.
最后按照 README 从头启动，完成展开、收起、刷新和键盘检查，再读一次差异。: Finally start from scratch using the README, check expansion, collapse, refresh, and keyboard use, then reread the diff. Confirm no temporary logs or fictional data slipped in before committing. Choose one clearly justified organizational goal next and continue small verified steps with recoverable versions.
评审者能复现你的结论吗？: Can a reviewer reproduce your conclusion?
预测仅写“优化完成”能否帮助同事验收；按你的交付说明重跑测试和按钮流程，解释哪些: Predict whether “optimization complete” helps a colleague accept the work. Rerun tests and the button flow from your handoff instructions and explain which evidence supports preserved behavior.
交付一份重构说明：问题、内部变化、保持的行为、检查结果、回退点和未覆盖范围；从说: Deliver a refactor note with the problem, internal change, preserved behavior, check results, rollback point, and uncovered scope. Follow it from scratch once.
变化理由具体可核对。: The reason for change is specific and checkable.
证据写明执行方式与结果。: Evidence states execution methods and results.
未覆盖项没有混成通过。: Uncovered items are not reported as passing.
最有说服力的重构总结是？: Which refactor summary is most convincing?
说明具体结构变化并附保持行为的检查记录。: Describe the specific structural change and include behavior-preservation check records.
改善与证据相连，便于接手者审阅。: Connecting improvements to evidence helps the next person review them.
代码更像专业工程师写的。: The code looks more professionally written.
主观印象无法说明行为保持。: A subjective impression does not establish preserved behavior.
用了更多框架所以不会出错。: More frameworks were used, so errors are impossible.
